环境视角下这是一个 bandit（一次决策、一个奖励、回合结束）；实现视角下 PPO 内部每个 token 是一个时间步，KL 惩罚和价值估计都按 token 算。

From the environment's view this is a bandit (one decision, one reward, episode over); from the implementation's view each token inside PPO is a time step, and the KL penalty and value estimates are per token.

大白话版 Step 3：有个裁判（RM）能给任何答案打分；让模型用自己的话回答一个提示；请裁判打分；推一下模型：高分答案变得更可能、低分答案更不可能；重复 256k 个提示。和 SFT 的区别：SFT 的答案是人写的、概率永远往上推、学会模仿；RL 的答案是模型自己写的、裁判喜欢就往上推不喜欢就往下推、学会超过自己的平均水平。RL = 在模型自己的答案上做 SFT，再按裁判的分数加权；新东西是负权重，模型也学会了「不该说什么」。

Step 3 in plain words: a judge (the RM) can score any answer; let the model answer a prompt in its own words; ask the judge for a score; nudge the model so high-scoring answers become more likely and low-scoring ones less likely; repeat for 256k prompts. Versus SFT: SFT answers are written by labelers, their probability is always pushed up, and the model learns to imitate; RL answers are written by the model, pushed up if the judge likes them and down if not, and the model learns to beat its own average. RL = SFT on the model's own answers, weighted by the judge's score; the new ingredient is the negative weight — the model also learns what not to say.

只最大化 E[r_θ(x, y)] 会出两个问题：① 奖励作弊（reward hacking）：模型找到骗过裁判的怪文本，因为 RM 只在它训练过的答案附近可靠；② 遗忘：阅读理解、翻译等裁判从不问的能力退化。完整目标（论文公式 2，要最大化）：

Maximising only E[r_θ(x, y)] goes wrong in two ways: (1) reward hacking — the model finds strange text that fools the judge, since the RM is reliable only near answers it was trained on; (2) forgetting — skills the judge never asks about (reading comprehension, translation) regress. The full objective (Equation 2 of the paper, maximised):

objective(ϕ)=E(x,y)∼DπϕRL[ rθ(x,y)⏟(1) judge’s score−βlog⁡πϕRL(y∣x)πSFT(y∣x)⏟(2) KL leash]+γ Ex∼Dpretrain[log⁡πϕRL(x)]⏟(3) pre-training mix\mathrm{objective}(\phi) = \mathbb{E}_{(x,y)\sim D_{\pi_\phi^{\mathrm{RL}}}}\Bigl[\,\underbrace{r_\theta(x,y)}_{(1)\ \text{judge's score}} - \underbrace{\beta\log\frac{\pi_\phi^{\mathrm{RL}}(y\mid x)}{\pi^{\mathrm{SFT}}(y\mid x)}}_{(2)\ \text{KL leash}}\Bigr] + \underbrace{\gamma\,\mathbb{E}_{x\sim D_{\mathrm{pretrain}}}\bigl[\log\pi_\phi^{\mathrm{RL}}(x)\bigr]}_{(3)\ \text{pre-training mix}}objective(ϕ)=E(x,y)∼DπϕRL​​​[(1) judge’s scorerθ​(x,y)​​−(2) KL leashβlogπSFT(y∣x)πϕRL​(y∣x)​​​]+(3) pre-training mixγEx∼Dpretrain​​[logπϕRL​(x)]​​

  • (1) 奖励项：要裁判喜欢的答案；需要冻结的 RM。

    (1) Reward term: produce what the judge likes; needs the frozen RM.

  • (2) KL 项（缰绳）：答案的概率每偏离 SFT 一点就付代价，防止奖励作弊、保持流畅；需要冻结的 SFT 参照。

    (2) KL term (the leash): pay for every bit the answer's probability drifts from SFT; prevents reward hacking and keeps outputs fluent; needs the frozen SFT reference.

  • (3) 预训练混合（ptx）：继续在 GPT-3 预训练数据上做下一个词预测（写成 + log π 是因为在最大化），量只有预训练的约 1/1000，并和 (1)(2) 放进同一步梯度，权重 γ。防止遗忘；不需要额外模型。

    (3) Pre-training mix (ptx): keep doing next-token prediction on GPT-3's pre-training data (written + log π because we maximise), about 1/1000 of the pre-training amount, in the same gradient step as (1)+(2) with weight γ. Prevents forgetting; needs no extra model.

  • β = 0.02、γ = 27.8。PPO = (1) + (2)；PPO-ptx = 三项全有 = InstructGPT。

    β = 0.02, γ = 27.8. PPO = (1) + (2); PPO-ptx = all three = InstructGPT.

PPO 怎么优化（大白话）：① 采 512 个提示，当前模型各写一个答案（温度 1）；② RM 打分，每个 token 减去 KL 代价；③ 在这批上走几小步梯度，提高好答案概率、降低差答案概率；④ 扔掉这批，重新采样，共 256k 个答案。PPO 的关键技巧：一次更新里任何 token 的概率变化不超过约 20%（裁剪，ε = 0.2）。步子太大模型会崩，崩了以后每个新样本都是垃圾，回不来。Proximal = 别离原来太远。

How PPO optimises (plain words): (1) sample 512 prompts and let the current model write one answer each (temperature 1); (2) score each with the RM and subtract the per-token KL price; (3) take a few small gradient steps on this batch to raise good answers and lower bad ones; (4) discard the batch and resample, 256k answers in total. The trick that makes it PPO: no token's probability may change by more than about 20% in one update (clipping, ε = 0.2). Big jumps can collapse the model, and once collapsed every new sample is garbage with no way back. Proximal = stay near where you were.

Step 3 的网络Network 大小Size 冻结？Frozen? 有梯度？Gradient? 作用Role
演员（PPO 策略）· Actor 175B，从 SFT 初始化init SFT 否no 是，公式 2yes, Eq. 2 最终产品the product
价值网络Value function 6B，从 RM 初始化init RM 否no 是，自己的回归损失yes, its own regression loss 降低梯度噪声，训练完丢弃lowers gradient noise; discarded after training
奖励模型Reward model 6B 是yes 否，只前向no, forward only 打分scores answers
参照 SFTReference SFT 175B 是yes 否，只前向no, forward only 提供 π^SFT 算 KLgives π^SFT for the KL price

价值网络干什么：它不在公式 2 里，不改变目标的值，但改变演员的梯度——每个 token 的梯度按 (分数 − V) 加权，而不是按原始分数。减去一个与答案无关的基线不改变梯度期望（对所有可能答案平均，V × 推力的和为 0），却能大大降低一个 minibatch（64 个答案）上的梯度噪声。例：V = 1.0，答案 1 得 1.5 ⇒ 权重 +0.5，往上推；答案 2 得 0.8 ⇒ 权重 −0.2，即使 0.8 > 0 也往下推；没有 V 两个都会被往上推。价值网络和演员一起训练（不冻结），用自己的回归损失 (V − 扣除 KL 后的实际分数)²，每个 token 都算；演员越来越好，分数上升，冻结的 V 会一直低估，所以 V 必须追着演员跑。

What the value function does: it is not in Equation 2 and does not change the objective's value, but it changes the actor's gradient — each token's gradient is weighted by (score − V) instead of the raw score. Subtracting a baseline that does not depend on the answer leaves the expected gradient unchanged (averaged over all answers, V × push sums to zero) but greatly reduces gradient noise on a 64-answer minibatch. Example: V = 1.0; answer 1 scores 1.5 ⇒ weight +0.5, pushed up; answer 2 scores 0.8 ⇒ weight −0.2, pushed down even though 0.8 > 0; without V both would be pushed up. The value function is trained alongside the actor (not frozen) with its own regression loss (V − actual score after the KL price)², per token; as the actor improves its scores rise, so a frozen V would keep under-estimating — V has to chase the actor.

手算例题：价值网络一次更新（课件原题）· Worked example: one value-function update

价值头 V = wᵀh + b，h = (0.5, −0.5, 1.0)，w = (0.8, 0.2, 0.7)，b = 0。前向 V = 0.40 − 0.10 + 0.70 = 1.0；答案扣除 KL 后实际得分 R = 1.5。演员用的优势 = R − V = +0.5；V 自己的损失 L_V = (V − R)² = 0.25，∂L_V/∂V = 2(V − R) = −1.0 ⇒ ∂L/∂w = −1.0·h = (−0.5, 0.5, −1.0)，∂L/∂b = −1.0。SGD（η = 0.1）：w → (0.85, 0.15, 0.80)，b → 0.1；新 V = 0.425 − 0.075 + 0.8 + 0.1 = 1.25，朝 1.5 移动，下次同样的答案只得到 0.25 的推力。同一个旧 V = 1.0 用了两次：在演员的优势里当常数、在 V 自己的损失里当预测；两个损失、两个网络，梯度互不流通。

Value head V = wᵀh + b with h = (0.5, −0.5, 1.0), w = (0.8, 0.2, 0.7), b = 0. Forward: V = 1.0; the answer's actual score after the KL price is R = 1.5. The actor's advantage = R − V = +0.5; V's own loss L_V = (V − R)² = 0.25, ∂L_V/∂V = −1.0 ⇒ ∂L/∂w = (−0.5, 0.5, −1.0), ∂L/∂b = −1.0. SGD (η = 0.1): w → (0.85, 0.15, 0.80), b → 0.1; new V = 1.25, moving toward 1.5, so next time the same answer gets a push of only 0.25. The old V = 1.0 is used twice: as a constant in the actor's advantage and as a prediction in V's own loss; two losses, two networks, no gradient flows between them.

手算例题：3 个 token 的 KL 代价与逐 token 回报（课件原题）· Worked example: KL price and per-token returns on a 3-token answer

  • 长度为什么总能对上：SFT 模型根本不生成，答案 y 只由 RL 模型写；SFT 只是被逐 token 地问「在这个前缀后你会给 yₜ 多大概率」（teacher forcing），两行给同样的 token 打分，长度自然一致。

    Why the lengths always match: the SFT model never generates; only the RL model writes y, and SFT is just asked token by token what probability it would give yₜ after this prefix (teacher forcing). Both rows score the same tokens.

  • π^RL = (0.6, 0.4, 0.3)，π^SFT = (0.4, 0.5, 0.3) ⇒ log 比 = (ln 1.5, ln 0.8, 0) = (0.405, −0.223, 0)，总偏离 0.182。β = 0.1（演示用）、裁判分 1.5 ⇒ 扣 KL 后 1.5 − 0.0182 = 1.482。y₁ 概率往上偏，收费；y₂ 往下偏，退钱；y₃ 没变，免费。

    π^RL = (0.6, 0.4, 0.3), π^SFT = (0.4, 0.5, 0.3) ⇒ log-ratios (0.405, −0.223, 0), total drift 0.182. With β = 0.1 (for illustration) and judge score 1.5 ⇒ 1.5 − 0.0182 = 1.482. y₁ drifted up: charged; y₂ drifted down: refunded; y₃ unchanged: free.

  • 逐 token 即时信号 rₜ = −β·log(π^RL/π^SFT)，RM 分数只加在最后一个 token：r = (−0.0405, +0.0223, 0 + 1.5)。回报从后往前加 Gₜ = rₜ + Gₜ₊₁ ⇒ G = (1.4818, 1.5223, 1.5)。V = (1.0, 1.2, 1.4) ⇒ 平方误差 (0.232, 0.104, 0.010)，价值损失 0.346/3 = 0.115；演员优势 Gₜ − Vₜ = (+0.48, +0.32, +0.10)——早期 token 对结尾不确定，V 较低，优势最大，第一个 token 得到最大的推力。（论文用 GAE，是 Gₜ 的平滑版，思路相同。）

    Per-token signal rₜ = −β·log(π^RL/π^SFT), with the RM score added only at the last token: r = (−0.0405, +0.0223, 0 + 1.5). Returns computed backwards Gₜ = rₜ + Gₜ₊₁ ⇒ G = (1.4818, 1.5223, 1.5). With V = (1.0, 1.2, 1.4), squared errors (0.232, 0.104, 0.010), value loss 0.346/3 = 0.115; actor advantages Gₜ − Vₜ = (+0.48, +0.32, +0.10) — early tokens are least sure how the answer ends, so V is lowest and the first token gets the biggest push. (The paper uses GAE, a smoothed Gₜ; same idea.)

  • 数据：31k 个训练提示，全部来自 API 用户，没有任何人工标签；共 256k 个回合（每个提示约 8 个回答）；温度 1 采样（要探索）；回答上限 1k token。ptx 项：随机取 GPT-3 预训练文本，数量是 RL 回合的 8 倍（比例 4 时预训练损失上升，32 时更好但慢好几倍，选 8）。

    Data: 31k training prompts, all from API users, with no human labels; 256k episodes (about 8 answers per prompt); temperature-1 sampling (exploration); answers capped at 1k tokens. ptx term: random GPT-3 pre-training text, 8× as many examples as RL episodes (ratio 4 lets the pre-training loss creep up; 32 is better but several times slower; 8 chosen).

  • 优化器：演员 Adam（β₁ = 0.9、β₂ = 0.95），10 次迭代 warm-up 后恒定学习率；batch 512 个回合、minibatch 64、每批 1 个内层 epoch；裁剪 ε = 0.2；GAE 不打折；权重 EMA 0.992。价值网络 6B、从 RM 初始化，学习率 9 × 10⁻⁶（175B 策略用 5 × 10⁻⁶）。PPO 不从 16 epoch 的 SFT 开始，而从混入 10% 预训练数据的 2 epoch SFT 开始（更稳）。β = 0.02、γ = 27.8；β 取 0 和 2 都不好，最优约 0.01–0.02；batch 512 最好；PPO-ptx 比纯 PPO 对学习率更不敏感（纯 PPO 在 8 × 10⁻⁶ 以上发散）。

    Optimizer: actor Adam (β₁ = 0.9, β₂ = 0.95), constant LR after a 10-iteration warm-up; batch 512 episodes, minibatch 64, one inner epoch per batch; clip ε = 0.2; GAE with no discount; weight EMA 0.992. Value function 6B, initialised from the RM, LR 9 × 10⁻⁶ (5 × 10⁻⁶ for the 175B policy). PPO starts not from the 16-epoch SFT but from a 2-epoch SFT run with 10% pre-training data mixed in (more stable). β = 0.02, γ = 27.8; β = 0 and β = 2 are both bad, the optimum is about 0.01–0.02; batch 512 is best; PPO-ptx is far less LR-sensitive than plain PPO (which diverged above 8 × 10⁻⁶).

Step 3 的四道计算题（课件 Quiz 5、6b，必会）· Four Step-3 calculations (lecture Quiz 5 and 6b, must know)

  • Quiz 5a：一个回合是什么？答 B：一个提示 → 完整回答 → 最后一个标量奖励。256k 个回合 = 256k 个（提示, 回答, 奖励）三元组，每批 512 个。A 错：RM 给整段打分，token 只直接得到 KL 惩罚；C、D 是优化单位，不是与环境的交互。

    Quiz 5a: what is one episode? Answer B: one prompt → a complete answer → one scalar reward at the end. 256k episodes = 256k (prompt, answer, reward) triples, in batches of 512. A is wrong: the RM scores whole answers and tokens directly receive only the KL penalty; C and D are optimisation units, not interactions with the environment.

  • Quiz 5b 显存：四个网络 175 + 175 + 6 + 6 = 362B 参数；仅 fp16 权重 362 × 10⁹ × 2 = 724 GB。可训练参数每个 2（fp16 权重）+ 2（fp16 梯度）+ 4 + 4 + 4（fp32 主权重和 Adam 两个矩）= 16 字节，冻结的只要 2 字节。可训练 181B × 16 = 2,896 GB，冻结 181B × 2 = 362 GB，共约 3,258 GB ≈ 3.3 TB ⇒ 至少 ⌈3258/80⌉ = 41 张 80 GB GPU，还没放一个激活。所以后来 DPO（不要 RM、不要价值网络）、GRPO（不要价值网络）很受欢迎。

    Quiz 5b memory: 175 + 175 + 6 + 6 = 362B parameters; fp16 weights alone 724 GB. A trainable parameter needs 2 (fp16 weight) + 2 (fp16 gradient) + 4 + 4 + 4 (fp32 master weight and two Adam moments) = 16 bytes; a frozen one 2 bytes. Trainable 181B × 16 = 2,896 GB, frozen 181B × 2 = 362 GB, about 3,258 GB ≈ 3.3 TB in total ⇒ at least 41 GPUs of 80 GB before any activation. Hence the appeal of DPO (no RM, no value net) and GRPO (no value net).

  • Quiz 5c 一次参数更新要几次梯度计算：一个 minibatch = 64 个采样答案 + 512 条预训练序列。(a) 有梯度：演员、价值网络；只前向：RM（给 64 个答案打分）、参照 SFT（给 KL 提供 π^SFT）。(b) (1)(2) 两项共用同一个 log π^RL，每个答案一次前向/反向 ⇒ 64 次；(3) 512 次；共 576 次穿过 175B 演员的反向，其中 89% 是为了「不遗忘」。(c) 一次更新：三项梯度累加成一个向量 ∇(1+2) + γ∇(3)，Adam 走一步；分三步会让三项互相拉扯，还要三次 175B 优化器状态更新。(d) 每批 512/64 = 8 次更新，共 256,000/512 = 500 批 ⇒ 4,000 次演员更新。梯度计算 = 反向传播；参数更新 = 优化器的一步。

    Quiz 5c gradient computations per update: one minibatch = 64 sampled answers + 512 pre-training sequences. (a) Gradients: actor and value function; forward only: RM (scores the 64 answers) and reference SFT (gives π^SFT for the KL price). (b) Terms (1)+(2) share the same log π^RL, one forward/backward per answer ⇒ 64; term (3) ⇒ 512; total 576 backward passes through the 175B actor, 89% of them spent on not forgetting. (c) One update: the three gradients are accumulated into ∇(1+2) + γ∇(3) and Adam takes one step; three separate steps would let the terms fight and cost three 175B optimizer-state updates. (d) 512/64 = 8 updates per batch, 256,000/512 = 500 batches ⇒ 4,000 actor updates. Gradient computation = backward pass; parameter update = one optimizer step.

  • Quiz 5d 对齐有多贵：预训练 3,640 PF-day；175B SFT 4.9；175B PPO-ptx 60。(a) (4.9 + 60)/3640 = 64.9/3640 ≈ 1.8%。(b) 60 × 10¹⁵ × 86,400 = 5.18 × 10²¹ FLOP；1,000 张 100 TFLOP/s 的 GPU = 10¹⁷ FLOP/s ⇒ 5.18 × 10⁴ s ≈ 14.4 小时。不到 2% 的算力，标注员却 85% 的时候更喜欢后训练过的 175B。后训练不改变模型大小：1.3B InstructGPT 就是后训练过的 1.3B GPT-3，不是压缩的 175B。

    Quiz 5d cost of alignment: pre-training 3,640 PF-days; 175B SFT 4.9; 175B PPO-ptx 60. (a) 64.9/3640 ≈ 1.8%. (b) 60 × 10¹⁵ × 86,400 = 5.18 × 10²¹ FLOP; 1,000 GPUs at 100 TFLOP/s = 10¹⁷ FLOP/s ⇒ 5.18 × 10⁴ s ≈ 14.4 hours. Under 2% of the compute, yet labelers prefer the post-trained 175B model 85% of the time. Post-training never changes model size: 1.3B InstructGPT is the 1.3B GPT-3 after post-training, not a compressed 175B model.

  • Quiz 6b Step 3 的算力花在哪：每 token 求梯度 10 FLOP/参数；(1)(2)：batch 64、每条 100 token ⇒ 1.75 × 10¹¹ × 6,400 × 10 = 1.12 × 10¹⁶；(3)：batch 2048 × 100 ⇒ 3.58 × 10¹⁷；(3) 占 3.58/(3.58 + 0.112) ≈ 97%。RL 本身只占 3%（实际全程约 1 亿 token），预训练正则约 100 亿 token：InstructGPT 训练的算力瓶颈是「保持通用语言能力」，不是强化学习。

    Quiz 6b where Step 3 compute goes: 10 FLOPs per parameter per token for the gradient; terms (1)+(2): batch 64 × 100 tokens ⇒ 1.75 × 10¹¹ × 6,400 × 10 = 1.12 × 10¹⁶; term (3): batch 2048 × 100 ⇒ 3.58 × 10¹⁷; term (3) is 3.58/(3.58 + 0.112) ≈ 97%. RL itself is only 3% (about 100 million tokens over the real run) versus about 10 billion tokens of pre-training regularisation: the compute bottleneck is preserving general language ability, not RL.

6. 效果、对齐税与遗留问题Results, the alignment tax and remaining mistakes

  • 对齐税：纯 PPO 在公开基准（SQuADv2、DROP、HellaSwag、WMT 法→英）上退步，忘了 RM 从不问的能力。PPO-ptx 混入预训练梯度后大部分恢复，HellaSwag 甚至超过 GPT-3。只加大 β 不行：β = 2.0（默认 100 倍）DROP/SQuAD 仍退步，奖励也毁了。KL 项只在 RL 提示上把策略拉近 SFT，管不到 RL 期间从没见过的阅读理解文章；只有在预训练文本上的梯度能保护预训练能力。设计教训：在你关心的数据空间里做正则，而不仅是在当前任务的参数/输出空间里。

    Alignment tax: plain PPO regresses on public benchmarks (SQuADv2, DROP, HellaSwag, WMT Fr→En), forgetting skills the RM never asks for. PPO-ptx mixes in pre-training gradients and recovers most of it, even beating GPT-3 on HellaSwag. Raising β instead does not work: β = 2.0 (100× default) leaves DROP/SQuAD regressed and destroys the reward. The KL term keeps the policy near SFT only on RL prompts; it says nothing about reading-comprehension passages never seen during RL. Only gradients on pre-training text protect pre-training skills. Design lesson: regularise in the data space you care about, not only in the parameter/output space of the task at hand.

  • 人类评估：胜率 = 标注员相对 175B SFT 更喜欢某模型输出的比例（留出提示、留出客户）。每个大小都是 GPT < GPT（精心提示）< SFT < PPO ≈ PPO-ptx。1.3B PPO-ptx 胜过 175B GPT-3（参数少 100 倍）。175B InstructGPT 对 175B GPT-3 胜 85 ± 3%，对少样本 GPT-3 胜 71 ± 4%。没提供训练数据的留出标注员也同意。

    Human evaluation: win rate = how often labelers prefer a model's output to the 175B SFT model's (held-out prompts and customers). At every size GPT < GPT (prompted) < SFT < PPO ≈ PPO-ptx. 1.3B PPO-ptx beats 175B GPT-3 with 100× fewer parameters. 175B InstructGPT beats 175B GPT-3 85 ± 3% of the time and few-shot GPT-3 71 ± 4%. Held-out labelers agree.

维度Axis 指标Measure GPT-3 → InstructGPT
遵循指令Instruction following 尝试正确指令attempts correct instruction 大幅提升large increase
显式约束Explicit constraints 如「两段以内」· e.g. "2 paragraphs or less" 大幅提升large increase
幻觉Hallucination 封闭域任务closed-domain tasks 41% → 21%
真实性Truthfulness TruthfulQA 约 2 倍about 2×
毒性Toxicity RealToxicityPrompts（礼貌提示）· respectful prompt 约少 25%≈ 25% fewer
偏见Bias Winogender、CrowS-Pairs 无改善no improvement
对 FLAN / T0vs FLAN / T0 直接偏好head-to-head preference 胜 78% / 79%78% / 79% wins

FLAN/T0（在公开 NLP 任务上加指令微调）介于精心提示的 GPT-3 和 SFT 之间：光微调不够，数据分布要和真实使用一致。还能泛化：微调数据 > 96% 是英文、几乎没有代码，却能听法语/瑞典语指令、解释代码。

FLAN/T0 (fine-tuning on public NLP tasks with instructions) land between prompted GPT-3 and SFT: fine-tuning alone is not enough; the data must match real usage. It also generalises: over 96% of the fine-tuning data is English with almost no code, yet it follows French/Swedish instructions and explains code.

仍有简单错误：「冥想后为什么要吃袜子」⇒ 接受了错误前提（训练里这类提示很少）；「炮弹打南瓜会怎样」⇒ 过度含糊（标注员被要求奖励谦逊，RM 学会奖励含糊，PPO 钻了这个空子）。最终模型的每个行为都能追溯到数据管线里的某个选择：我们对齐的到底是谁？——40 名外包、OpenAI 的指令、Playground 用户。

It still makes simple mistakes: "why is it important to eat socks after meditating" ⇒ accepts a false premise (few such prompts in training); "what happens if you fire a cannonball at a pumpkin" ⇒ over-hedges (labelers were told to reward epistemic humility, the RM learned to reward hedging, and PPO exploited it). Every behaviour of the final model traces back to a pipeline choice: who are we aligning to? — 40 contractors, OpenAI's instructions and Playground users.

  • 课堂 Quiz 6a：第三项 γE[log π(x)] 的主要目的？答 C：保留预训练学到的通用语言能力（纯 PPO 会损失，即对齐税）。A、B 说的是 KL 项；D：论文用温度 1 探索，没有熵奖励。

    Lecture Quiz 6a: the main purpose of the third term γE[log π(x)]? Answer C: preserve the general language abilities from pre-training that plain PPO degrades (the alignment tax). A and B describe the KL term; D: the paper explores with temperature 1 and uses no entropy bonus.

  • 课堂 Quiz 7a：1.3B InstructGPT 胜过 175B GPT-3 怎么解释？答 C：在真实用户提示上，对齐用户意图比原始能力更重要，对齐比扩大 100 倍便宜得多。知识和推理仍随规模增长（175B InstructGPT 处处胜过 1.3B）；1.3B 只在 13k 条示范上微调，学到的是行为不是 100 倍的知识（A 错）；论文也测了精心设计的少样本提示，仍输 71%（D 错）。

    Lecture Quiz 7a: how to read 1.3B InstructGPT beating 175B GPT-3? Answer C: on real user prompts, alignment with user intent matters more than raw capability, and alignment is far cheaper than a 100× scale-up. Knowledge still scales with size (175B InstructGPT beats 1.3B everywhere); the 1.3B model is fine-tuned on 13k demonstrations and learns a behaviour, not 100× more facts (A wrong); a carefully designed few-shot prompt was also tested and still lost 71% (D wrong).

  • 课堂 Quiz 7b：Bradley–Terry 下 Δ = ln(p/(1 − p))。85% ⇒ ln(0.85/0.15) = ln 5.667 = 1.73；71% ⇒ ln 2.448 = 0.90——好的少样本提示弥补了约一半的奖励差距。RM 准确率/人人一致率 = 69.6/72.6 = 0.959，离人类上限不到 4%。奖励的单位 = 人类偏好的对数几率，胜率和 RM 输出可以互相换算。

    Lecture Quiz 7b: under Bradley–Terry Δ = ln(p/(1 − p)). 85% ⇒ ln 5.667 = 1.73; 71% ⇒ ln 2.448 = 0.90 — a good few-shot prompt closes about half the reward gap. RM accuracy / human agreement = 69.6/72.6 = 0.959, within 4% of the human ceiling. The unit of reward is the log-odds of human preference, so win rates and RM outputs convert into each other.

7. 总结与后续Summary and what came after

  1. GPT-3 和 ChatGPT 的差别是目标不是结构：预训练优化「预测网页」，后训练优化「按用户意思办」，同样的权重、同样的网络。

    The gap between GPT-3 and ChatGPT is an objective, not an architecture: pre-training optimises "predict the web", post-training "do what the user meant"; same weights, same network.

  2. 三步三个模型：SFT 示范行为，RM 学会评判，PPO 对着裁判改进策略，KL 缰绳和预训练混合防止跑偏和遗忘。

    Three steps, three models: SFT shows the behaviour, the RM learns to judge it, PPO improves the policy against the judge while the KL leash and the pre-training mix stop drifting and forgetting.

  3. 人用在最便宜的地方：写少量答案（Step 1）→ 排大量答案（Step 2）→ 退出循环（Step 3）。

    Humans are used where cheapest: write a few answers (Step 1), rank many (Step 2), then step out of the loop (Step 3).

  4. 对齐便宜又有效：< 2% 预训练算力，不改模型大小。

    Alignment is cheap and powerful: < 2% of pre-training compute, no change in model size.

  5. 这是系统问题：四个大网络同时在显存里，256k 次生成，大部分梯度算力花在「不遗忘」上。

    It is a systems problem: four large networks in memory, 256k generations, most gradient FLOPs spent on not forgetting.

  6. 模型只和数据管线一样好：含糊、错误前提、偏见都能追溯到标注指令和数据。

    The model is only as good as the pipeline: hedging, false premises and bias trace back to labeler instructions and data.

后续：ChatGPT（2022.11）= 同样三步用在 GPT-3.5，SFT 数据写成对话（训练员同时扮演用户和助手），比较数据来自多轮对话。DPO（2023）：把带 KL 的目标解析求解 ⇒ 不要 RM、不要 PPO，只在偏好对上做一个分类损失。GRPO（2024）：去掉价值网络，用一组样本的平均奖励作基线。可验证奖励的 RL：用检查器（单元测试、最终答案）代替学来的 RM，是推理模型的基础。它们都保留今天的结构：从 SFT 初始化的策略 + 一个奖励 + 拴向参照模型的缰绳。

After: ChatGPT (Nov 2022) = the same three steps on GPT-3.5, with SFT data written as dialogues (trainers play both user and assistant) and comparisons from multi-turn conversations. DPO (2023) solves the KL-regularised objective in closed form ⇒ no RM, no PPO, just a classification loss on preference pairs. GRPO (2024) drops the value network and uses the mean reward of a group of samples as the baseline. RL with verifiable rewards replaces the learned RM with a checker (unit tests, final answers) — the basis of reasoning models. All keep today's structure: a policy initialised from SFT, a reward, and a leash to the reference model.

Lecture 11 Quiz 答案与关键步骤Lecture 11 Quiz answers and key steps

  • Q1 四个网络的显存预算（演员、参照各 P B 参数；RM 从 6.40B 的 LM 去掉 8,000 × 50,000 输出层、加 8,000 → 1 标量头；价值网络同 RM；24 张 80 GB GPU，每张留 16 GB）：

    Q1 memory budget for four networks (actor and reference P B each; the RM is a 6.40B LM minus its 8,000 × 50,000 output layer plus an 8,000 → 1 scalar head; the value model matches the RM; 24 GPUs of 80 GB with 16 GB reserved each):

    • RM/价值网络参数 Q = 6,400,000,000 − 400,000,000 + 8,000 = 6,000,008,000，q = 6.000008（B）。

      RM/value parameters Q = 6,400,000,000 − 400,000,000 + 8,000 = 6,000,008,000, q = 6.000008 (B).

    • 可训练（演员、价值网络）16 字节/参数，冻结（参照、RM）2 字节 ⇒ 总量 16P + 16q + 2P + 2q = 18(P + q) GB。

      Trainable (actor, value) 16 bytes/parameter, frozen (reference, RM) 2 bytes ⇒ 16P + 16q + 2P + 2q = 18(P + q) GB.

    • 可用 24 × (80 − 16) = 1,536 GB ⇒ P ≤ 1536/18 − 6.000008 ≈ 79.33 ⇒ P = 79。验证：P = 79 用 1,530.000144 GB ≤ 1,536；P = 80 用 1,548.000144 GB > 1,536。

      Available 24 × 64 = 1,536 GB ⇒ P ≤ 79.33 ⇒ P = 79. Check: P = 79 uses 1,530.000144 GB ≤ 1,536; P = 80 uses 1,548.000144 GB > 1,536.

  • Q2 带 padding 的 SFT 平均损失（A = [0, 2, 1, pad]，B = [2, pad, pad, pad]，pad 的 ID 和 token 0 相同但单独标记）：

    Q2 mean SFT loss with padding (A = [0, 2, 1, pad], B = [2, pad, pad, pad]; pad shares token 0's ID but is marked separately):

    • 有效 token 3 + 1 = 4 个（A 的第一个 0 是真 token，要算）。

      4 valid tokens (A's first 0 is a real token and counts).

    • 正确词概率：A₁ (ln 2, 0, 0) → (1/2, 1/4, 1/4) 取 1/2；A₂ (0, ln 2, 0) → 目标 2 的 1/4（即使 token 1 最大）；A₃ (ln 2, ln 2, 0) → (2/5, 2/5, 1/5) 目标 1 的 2/5；B₁ (ln 4, 0, ln 2) → (4/7, 1/7, 2/7) 目标 2 的 2/7。

      Correct-target probabilities: A₁ 1/2; A₂ 1/4 (target 2, even though token 1 is highest); A₃ 2/5; B₁ 2/7.

    • L = −ln[(1/2)(1/4)(2/5)(2/7)]/4 = −ln(1/70)/4 = ln 70/4 ≈ 1.062。先在序列内平均再平均会给 B 唯一的 token 过大的权重。

      L = −ln(1/70)/4 = ln 70/4 ≈ 1.062. Averaging per sequence first would over-weight B's single token.

  • Q3 全排序的 RM 损失（r = wᵀh + 2，w = (ln 2, −ln 2)；排序 D ≻ C ≻ A ≻ B）：

    Q3 RM loss from a full ranking (r = wᵀh + 2, w = (ln 2, −ln 2); ranking D ≻ C ≻ A ≻ B):

    • r(A) = 2 + ln 2，r(B) = 2 − ln 2，r(C) = r(D) = 2（模型目前排 A > C = D > B，和人不一致）。

      r(A) = 2 + ln 2, r(B) = 2 − ln 2, r(C) = r(D) = 2 (the model ranks A > C = D > B, disagreeing with humans).

    • 6 对，偏好方向在前：D≻C Δ = 0 ⇒ 1/2；D≻A、C≻A Δ = −ln 2 ⇒ 1/3；D≻B、C≻B Δ = ln 2 ⇒ 2/3；A≻B Δ = ln 4 ⇒ 4/5。偏置 2 在差值里消掉；非相邻对也要算；分数相同的 D≻C 也算。

      Six pairs, preferred first: D≻C Δ = 0 ⇒ 1/2; D≻A and C≻A Δ = −ln 2 ⇒ 1/3; D≻B and C≻B Δ = ln 2 ⇒ 2/3; A≻B Δ = ln 4 ⇒ 4/5. The bias 2 cancels; non-adjacent pairs count; the tied pair D≻C still counts.

    • 乘积 (1/2)(1/3)(2/3)(1/3)(2/3)(4/5) = 8/405 ⇒ L = ln(405/8)/6 ≈ 0.654。

      Product = 8/405 ⇒ L = ln(405/8)/6 ≈ 0.654.

  • Q4 预算内最多几个比较（200 个提示；排 4 个答案每条 160 token，或排 9 个每条 240 token；前向预算 300,000 token；每个回答前向一次、奖励复用）：

    Q4 maximum comparisons within budget (200 prompts; rank 4 answers at 160 tokens each or 9 at 240; forward budget 300,000 tokens; one forward pass per answer, rewards reused):

    • 4 个：代价 4 × 160 = 640，比较 6；9 个：代价 9 × 240 = 2,160，比较 36。

      4 answers: cost 640, 6 comparisons; 9 answers: cost 2,160, 36 comparisons.

    • 设 x 个提示用 9 个：2160x + 640(200 − x) ≤ 300,000 ⇒ 1520x ≤ 172,000 ⇒ x ≤ 113.16 ⇒ x = 113，另外 87 个用 4 个。比较数 1,200 + 30x 随 x 增加。

      Let x prompts use 9: 1520x ≤ 172,000 ⇒ x = 113, the other 87 use 4. Comparisons 1,200 + 30x increase with x.

    • 最多 113 × 36 + 87 × 6 = 4,590 个比较；用掉 299,760 token；114 个会用 301,280 > 300,000。

      Maximum 4,590 comparisons using 299,760 tokens; 114 would use 301,280 > 300,000.

  • Q5 价值头一次更新（演员 log 概率 (−1, −3, −1)，参照 (−2, −2, −3)，β = 0.1，R = 1 只加在最后；w = (0.4, 0.2)，h₁ = (1, 0)、h₂ = (0, 1)、h₃ = (1, −1)，η = 0.3）：

    Q5 one value-head update (actor log-probs (−1, −3, −1), reference (−2, −2, −3), β = 0.1, R = 1 at the end; w = (0.4, 0.2), h₁ = (1, 0), h₂ = (0, 1), h₃ = (1, −1), η = 0.3):

    • d = (1, −1, 2) ⇒ r = (−0.1, 0.1, −0.2 + 1 = 0.8)；回报从后往前 G = (0.8, 0.9, 0.8)。

      d = (1, −1, 2) ⇒ r = (−0.1, 0.1, 0.8); returns backwards G = (0.8, 0.9, 0.8).

    • V = (0.4, 0.2, 0.2)，误差 V − G = (−0.4, −0.7, −0.6)。

      V = (0.4, 0.2, 0.2), errors V − G = (−0.4, −0.7, −0.6).

    • V₁ = w₁、V₂ = w₂、V₃ = w₁ − w₂ ⇒ ∂L/∂w₁ = (2/3)(−0.4 − 0.6) = −2/3，∂L/∂w₂ = (2/3)(−0.7 + 0.6) = −1/15（位置 2 要增大 w₂，位置 3 要减小，部分抵消）。

      V₁ = w₁, V₂ = w₂, V₃ = w₁ − w₂ ⇒ ∂L/∂w₁ = −2/3, ∂L/∂w₂ = −1/15 (position 2 wants w₂ up, position 3 down; they partly cancel).

    • w_new = (0.4 + 0.2, 0.2 + 0.02) = (0.60, 0.22)。

      w_new = (0.60, 0.22).

  • Q6 γ 取何值时 A 不差于 B（β = 0.2；A：RM 1.8，log 比 (0.4, −0.2, 0.3)，预训练 log 概率 −1.0、−2.4；B：RM 1.5，log 比 (0.1, 0, 0)，预训练 −0.8、−1.6）：

    Q6 for which γ is A no worse than B (β = 0.2; A: RM 1.8, log-ratios (0.4, −0.2, 0.3), pre-training log-probs −1.0, −2.4; B: RM 1.5, log-ratios (0.1, 0, 0), pre-training −0.8, −1.6):

    • log 比求和（不除以 3）：A 0.5、B 0.1 ⇒ A 1.8 − 0.1 = 1.7，B 1.5 − 0.02 = 1.48。

      Sum the log-ratios (no division by 3): A 0.5, B 0.1 ⇒ A 1.7, B 1.48.

    • 预训练平均：A −1.7、B −1.2 ⇒ J_A = 1.7 − 1.7γ，J_B = 1.48 − 1.2γ。

      Pre-training means: A −1.7, B −1.2 ⇒ J_A = 1.7 − 1.7γ, J_B = 1.48 − 1.2γ.

    • J_A ≥ J_B ⇔ 0.22 ≥ 0.5γ ⇔ 0 ≤ γ ≤ 0.44；γ = 0.44 时两者都是 0.952。

      J_A ≥ J_B ⇔ 0 ≤ γ ≤ 0.44; at γ = 0.44 both equal 0.952.

L11 易错点L11 common mistakes

  • RM 和参照 SFT 在 Step 3 都冻结；只有演员和价值网络有梯度。价值网络不属于最终产品。

    The RM and the reference SFT are both frozen in Step 3; only the actor and the value function receive gradients. The value function is not part of the product.

  • RL 模型大小必须等于 SFT（从它初始化）；RM 可以小得多（论文 6B）。后训练不改变模型大小。

    The RL model must be the same size as SFT (it is initialised from it); the RM can be much smaller (6B in the paper). Post-training never changes model size.

  • SFT 只在回答 token 上算损失；padding 用 label = −100 排除；batch 损失对全部有效 token 平均，不是先按序列平均。

    SFT computes the loss only on response tokens; padding is excluded with label = −100; the batch loss averages over all valid tokens, not per sequence first.

  • RM 损失对 C(K, 2) 对全部计入，包括非相邻对和分数相同的对；方向是「人偏好的减不偏好的」；偏置在差值里抵消。

    The RM loss includes all C(K, 2) pairs, including non-adjacent and tied ones; the difference is preferred minus non-preferred; biases cancel.

  • KL 项防奖励作弊，预训练混合项防遗忘（对齐税）；加大 β 不能代替 ptx。

    The KL term prevents reward hacking; the pre-training mix prevents forgetting (the alignment tax); a larger β cannot replace ptx.

  • 逐 token 回报从后往前加，RM 分数只加在最后一个 token；KL 的 log 比可以为负，保留符号。

    Per-token returns are summed backwards, with the RM score only at the last token; KL log-ratios can be negative — keep the sign.

  • 显存：可训练参数 16 字节（fp16 权重 + fp16 梯度 + fp32 主权重 + 两个 fp32 矩），冻结参数 2 字节；四个网络各自单独存，即使初始化相同。

    Memory: 16 bytes per trainable parameter (fp16 weight + fp16 gradient + fp32 master + two fp32 moments), 2 bytes per frozen one; all four networks are stored separately even if initialised identically.

LECTURE 12

扩散模型：Stable Diffusion 生成图像、Wan 生成视频

Diffusion Models: Stable Diffusion for Images, Wan for Video

本页目录

一句话：扩散模型先用一个固定公式一步步往图像里加高斯噪声（前向过程，不用学），再训练一个网络预测「加进去的噪声」（反向过程，唯一要学的部分）；生成时从纯噪声出发，每步减掉一点预测的噪声，20–50 步后得到图像。Stable Diffusion 在 VAE 压缩后的潜空间里做这件事，用交叉注意力读入文本；Wan 把它扩展到视频：3D VAE + Diffusion Transformer + flow matching。

In one sentence: a diffusion model first adds Gaussian noise to an image step by step with a fixed formula (the forward process, nothing learned), then trains a network to predict the added noise (the reverse process, the only learned part); to generate, it starts from pure noise and removes a little predicted noise per step, reaching an image after 20–50 steps. Stable Diffusion does this in the latent space of a VAE and reads the text through cross-attention; Wan extends it to video with a 3D VAE, a Diffusion Transformer and flow matching.

零基础先读Start here

  • 高斯噪声：每个数独立地取自均值 0、方差 1 的正态分布 N(0, I)，形状和图像相同。

    Gaussian noise: each number drawn independently from a normal distribution with mean 0 and variance 1, N(0, I), with the same shape as the image.

  • 生成 = 从分布里采样：GPT 学 p(下一个词 ∣ 前面的词)；图像模型要学 p(x)，x ∈ ℝ^(512×512×3)（786,432 个相关的实数），写不出来，只能找一个输出分布像真实图像的过程。三大家族：GAN、自回归、扩散；2022 年至今图像和视频由扩散胜出。

    Generation = sampling from a distribution: GPT learns p(next token ∣ previous tokens); an image model must learn p(x) over x ∈ ℝ^(512×512×3) (786,432 correlated reals), which cannot be written down, so we need a procedure whose output looks like real images. Three families: GANs, autoregressive models, diffusion; diffusion has won for images and video since 2022.

  • 潜空间（latent）：图像被编码器压缩后的小张量，比如 64 × 64 × 4。扩散在这里做，最后由解码器还原像素。

    Latent space: the small tensor an encoder compresses an image into, e.g. 64 × 64 × 4. Diffusion happens there; a decoder turns the result back into pixels.

  • 步数 t：表示噪声有多大。t 大几乎全是噪声，t 小几乎干净。

    Step t: how much noise there is. Large t is almost pure noise; small t is almost clean.

本课仍用四点框架（结构、损失、数据、优化器），分别填两次：Stable Diffusion（图像）和 Wan（视频）。选 Wan 是因为它是最强的开源视频模型（阿里 2025），权重、代码、技术报告都公开；Sora、Veo、海螺等闭源模型的四个格子填不出来。

The lecture again uses the four-part frame (architecture, loss, data, optimizer), filled twice: Stable Diffusion (images) and Wan (video). Wan is chosen because it is the strongest open video model (Alibaba, 2025) with public weights, code and technical report; for closed models like Sora, Veo or Hailuo the four boxes cannot be filled.

1. 为什么不一个像素一个像素地生成（课堂思考题 1）· Why not generate one pixel at a time (Think about it 1)

  • 长度：512 × 512 × 3 = 786,432 个值，要 786,432 次串行前向；一个 1,000 token 的 GPT 回答只要 1,000 次。

    Length: 786,432 values means 786,432 sequential forward passes; a 1,000-token GPT answer needs 1,000.

  • 顺序：文本有天然的从左到右，像素没有；光栅顺序逼模型在「知道」右下角之前就定下左上角。

    Order: text runs left to right; pixels have no natural order, and raster order forces the model to commit to the top-left before it knows the bottom-right.

  • 冗余：相邻像素几乎相同，大多数预测只是抄上一个像素，浪费算力；像素还是连续值，不是从词表里选，softmax 那一套不直接适用。

    Redundancy: neighbouring pixels are nearly identical, so most predictions just copy the previous pixel; and pixels are continuous, not vocabulary choices, so softmax-over-tokens does not fit directly.

  • 扩散的做法：一次生成所有像素，但很粗糙，然后几十步一起细化：先全局结构，后细节。

    Diffusion's alternative: generate all pixels at once, coarsely, then refine them all together over a few dozen steps — global structure first, details last.

2. 扩散基础：前向过程、反向过程、噪声预测器Diffusion fundamentals: forward, reverse, noise predictor

  • 前向过程：图像 → 一步步加高斯噪声 → 纯噪声。没有可学参数，是手工设计的配方；它的作用是制造反向过程的训练输入和标签。

    Forward process: image → add Gaussian noise step by step → pure noise. No learnable parameters; a hand-designed recipe whose job is to manufacture training inputs and labels for the reverse process.

  • 反向过程：纯噪声 → 一步步去噪 → 图像。输入「带噪图像 + 步数 t」，输出「稍微干净一点的图像」；同一个去噪网络每步都用，只有输入变；DDPM 和 SD 用 T = 1000（课件示意用 200）。这是唯一要学的部分（Ho, Jain, Abbeel，DDPM，NeurIPS 2020）。

    Reverse process: pure noise → denoise step by step → image. Input: noisy image + step t; output: a slightly cleaner image; the same denoising network is used at every step, only its inputs change; DDPM and SD use T = 1000 (the slides illustrate with 200). This is the only learned part (Ho, Jain, Abbeel, DDPM, NeurIPS 2020).

  • 为什么要 T 小步而不是一大步：把一个很难的问题（噪声 → 图像）拆成 T 个容易的（稍噪 → 稍干净）；每步只做小的局部修正，错了后面还能改；文本等条件可以每步注入一点。

    Why T small steps instead of one big one: split a very hard problem (noise → image) into T easy ones (slightly noisier → slightly cleaner); each step makes a small local correction that later steps can fix; conditions such as text can be injected a little at every step.

  • 为什么要输入 t：t 告诉网络输入里有多少噪声（t = 200 几乎全是噪声，t = 1 几乎没有）。t 大时要编出全局布局，t 小时只需修细节；告诉它 t，一个网络就能两种都做。

    Why input t: t tells the network how much noise is in its input. At large t it must invent the global layout; at small t it only polishes detail; given t, one network handles both.

损失怎么定（课堂思考题 2）· What is the loss (Think about it 2)

  1. 预测什么：不直接预测去噪后的图像（目标是复杂的自然图像，很难），而是预测加进去的噪声——和图像同形状的张量。噪声很「简单」（高斯，各处统计相同），图像再通过减去预测噪声得到（DDPM 精确公式还要缩放并加一点新噪声）。

    What to predict: not the denoised image directly (a complicated natural image is hard to predict), but the added noise — a tensor of the image's shape. Noise is "simple" (Gaussian, same statistics everywhere); the image is then recovered by subtracting the predicted noise (the exact DDPM update also rescales and adds a little fresh noise).

  2. 关键部分：去噪块里的噪声预测器 ε_θ(xₜ, t) 是扩散模型里唯一可训练的组件，加噪、减噪、缩放都是固定公式。DDPM 用 U-Net，Wan 用 Transformer，其余配方相同。

    The key part: the noise predictor ε_θ(xₜ, t) inside the denoising block is the only trainable component; adding noise, subtracting and rescaling are fixed formulas. DDPM uses a U-Net, Wan a Transformer; the rest of the recipe is the same.

  3. 真值从哪来：带噪图像是我们自己往干净图像上加噪声做出来的，所以噪声 ε 完全已知——免费的标签。训练对：输入 (xₜ, t)，标签 ε；不需要人工标注，每张图换 t 和 ε 能造无限多对。编号约定：前向第 t 步和撤销它的反向第 t 步同号；用 (x₁, t = 1) 训练出来的就是生成时最后一步用的那个。

    Where the ground truth comes from: we made the noisy image ourselves by adding noise to a clean one, so the noise ε is known exactly — a free label. Training pair: input (xₜ, t), label ε; no human labels, and every image yields unlimited pairs by resampling t and ε. Numbering: a forward step and the reverse step that undoes it share the same t; the predictor trained on (x₁, t = 1) is the one used for the last denoising step.

前向过程的精确形式The forward process, precisely

xt=1−βt xt−1+βt ϵt,ϵt∼N(0,I),Pr⁡(xt∣xt−1)=N(1−βt xt−1, βtI)x_t = \sqrt{1-\beta_t}\,x_{t-1} + \sqrt{\beta_t}\,\epsilon_t,\qquad \epsilon_t\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I),\qquad \Pr(x_t\mid x_{t-1}) = \mathcal{N}\bigl(\sqrt{1-\beta_t}\,x_{t-1},\ \beta_t I\bigr)xt​=1−βt​​xt−1​+βt​​ϵt​,ϵt​∼N(0,I),Pr(xt​∣xt−1​)=N(1−βt​​xt−1​, βt​I)

  • βₜ = 第 t 步加的噪声强度（方差）：信号缩一点、加一点噪声。T 步后 x_T 与 N(0, I) 无法区分。

    βₜ is the noise strength (variance) at step t: shrink the signal a little, add a little noise. After T steps x_T is indistinguishable from N(0, I).

  • 为什么是 √(1 − βₜ) 和 √βₜ：若 xₜ₋₁ 方差为 1，则 Var(xₜ) = (1 − βₜ)·1 + βₜ·1 = 1，方差永远保持 1，数不会爆炸也不会消失。

    Why √(1 − βₜ) and √βₜ: if xₜ₋₁ has unit variance, Var(xₜ) = (1 − βₜ) + βₜ = 1, so the variance stays at 1 forever — numbers never blow up or vanish.

  • 噪声表（schedule）：βₜ 不是网络算的、也不是学的，是训练前手选的 T 个数。DDPM 线性表：T = 1000，β₁ = 0.0001、β_T = 0.02，βₜ = β₁ + (t − 1)(β_T − β₁)/(T − 1)，每步多约 0.00002。SD 用「scaled-linear」（√βₜ 从 √0.00085 线性到 √0.012），也有余弦表，全是手工设计。

    The noise schedule: βₜ is neither computed by the network nor learned; it is a list of T numbers chosen before training. DDPM's linear schedule: T = 1000, β₁ = 0.0001, β_T = 0.02, βₜ = β₁ + (t − 1)(β_T − β₁)/(T − 1), about 0.00002 more each step. SD uses "scaled-linear" (√βₜ linear from √0.00085 to √0.012); cosine schedules also exist. All hand-designed.

t βₜ ᾱₜ（剩下的信号）· signal left √ᾱₜ（信号系数）· signal coefficient √(1 − ᾱₜ)（噪声系数）· noise coefficient
1 0.00010 0.9999 1.00 0.01
100 0.0021 0.90 0.95 0.32
500 0.0101 0.08 0.28 0.96
900 0.0180 0.0003 0.02 1.00
1000 0.0200 0.00004 0.006 1.00

每个 βₜ 都很小（最多 2%），但 1000 步后信号没了：ᾱ₁₀₀₀ ≈ 0。

Every βₜ is tiny (at most 2%), yet after 1000 steps the signal is gone: ᾱ₁₀₀₀ ≈ 0.

手算例题：两个像素的「图像」（课件原题）· Worked example: a two-pixel "image"

x₀ = (1.0, −1.0)，取 β₁ = 0.19 使 √(1 − β₁) = 0.9（真实 β₁ = 0.0001 太小看不出来，这里故意放大）。采样噪声 ε₁ = (0.5, −0.2) ⇒ x₁ = 0.9·(1.0, −1.0) + √0.19·(0.5, −0.2) = (0.9 + 0.218, −0.9 − 0.087) = (1.118, −0.987)。这一对的训练标签就是 ε₁ = (0.5, −0.2)。真实情况一模一样，只是 786,432 个数。

x₀ = (1.0, −1.0), with β₁ = 0.19 so √(1 − β₁) = 0.9 (the real β₁ = 0.0001 is too small to see; exaggerated on purpose). Noise ε₁ = (0.5, −0.2) ⇒ x₁ = 0.9·(1.0, −1.0) + √0.19·(0.5, −0.2) = (1.118, −0.987). This pair's training label is ε₁ = (0.5, −0.2). The real thing is identical with 786,432 numbers.

一步跳到任意 tJump to any step in one line

令 αₜ = 1 − βₜ，ᾱₜ = ∏ₛ≤ₜ αₛ（到目前为止所有缩小因子的乘积）。高斯之和仍是高斯，所以：

Let αₜ = 1 − βₜ and ᾱₜ = ∏ₛ≤ₜ αₛ (the product of all shrink factors so far). A sum of Gaussians is Gaussian, so:

xt=αˉt x0+1−αˉt ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,I)x_t = \sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon,\qquad \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)xt​=αˉt​​x0​+1−αˉt​​ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,I)

一次高斯采样就从 x₀ 到 xₜ，不用模拟 t 步；ᾱₜ 从约 1 降到约 0。训练因此很便宜：随机选 t、随机选 ε，标签就是这个 ε。例：ᾱₜ = 0.5，x₀ = (1.0, −1.0)，ε = (0.2, 0.6) ⇒ xₜ = 0.707·(1.0, −1.0) + 0.707·(0.2, 0.6) = (0.849, −0.283)。

One Gaussian sample takes x₀ to xₜ without simulating t steps; ᾱₜ falls from about 1 to about 0. Training is therefore cheap: pick a random t and a random ε, and the label is that ε. Example: ᾱₜ = 0.5, x₀ = (1.0, −1.0), ε = (0.2, 0.6) ⇒ xₜ = (0.849, −0.283).

注意：这里的 ε 是把前面所有步的噪声合起来、再标准化后的总噪声，不是最后一步的 εₜ。Lecture 12 Quiz Q1 就考这一点。

Note: this ε is the aggregate, standardised noise from all earlier steps, not the last step's εₜ alone. Lecture 12 Quiz Q1 tests exactly this.

损失：就是均方误差The loss: just mean squared error

L(θ)=Ex0∼data, t∼Uniform{1..T}, ϵ∼N(0,I)[∥ϵ−ϵθ(αˉt x0+1−αˉt ϵ, t)∥2]L(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{x_0\sim\text{data},\ t\sim\mathrm{Uniform}\{1..T\},\ \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)}\Bigl[\bigl\lVert \epsilon - \epsilon_\theta\bigl(\sqrt{\bar\alpha_t}\,x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}\,\epsilon,\ t\bigr)\bigr\rVert^2\Bigr]L(θ)=Ex0​∼data, t∼Uniform{1..T}, ϵ∼N(0,I)​[​ϵ−ϵθ​(αˉt​​x0​+1−αˉt​​ϵ, t)​2]

一步训练：① 从数据集取一张真实图像 x₀；② 采样 t 和 ε，用一行公式造 xₜ（前向过程）；③ 网络预测 ε̂ = ε_θ(xₜ, t)；④ 损失 = ε̂ 与真 ε 的平方距离，反向传播、更新 θ。例：真 ε = (0.2, 0.6)，预测 (0.3, 0.4) ⇒ 损失 0.01 + 0.04 = 0.05。这个 MSE 是 DDPM 论文里变分下界的简化版，作者发现简化版训练得更好。

One training step: (1) take a real image x₀; (2) sample t and ε and build xₜ with the one-line formula (forward process); (3) predict ε̂ = ε_θ(xₜ, t); (4) loss = squared distance between ε̂ and the true ε; backprop and update θ. Example: true ε = (0.2, 0.6), prediction (0.3, 0.4) ⇒ loss 0.01 + 0.04 = 0.05. This MSE simplifies the variational lower bound of the DDPM paper; the authors found the simple form trains better.

训练时 t 随机；只有生成时 t 按顺序走Training draws a random t; only generation walks t in order

训练（DDPM 算法 1）· Training 生成（DDPM 算法 2）· Generation
取 x₀；一个随机 t；取 ε；一行公式跳到 xₜ；对 ∥ε − ε_θ(xₜ, t)∥² 走一步梯度；重复take x₀; one random t; draw ε; jump to xₜ; one gradient step on ∥ε − ε_θ(xₜ, t)∥²; repeat x_T ~ N(0, I)；t = T, T − 1, …, 1 依次：ε̂ = ε_θ(xₜ, t)，xₜ₋₁ = 去掉一点 ε̂、加一点新噪声；返回 x₀x_T ~ N(0, I); for t = T, …, 1 in sequence: ε̂ = ε_θ(xₜ, t), xₜ₋₁ = remove a bit of ε̂, add a bit of fresh noise; return x₀

常见误解：「训练时每张图都要走 t = 1…1000」——不是。SD 训练代码就一行 t = torch.randint(0, 1000, (batch_size,))，batch 里每张图各自一个随机 t。一张图、一个 t、一个损失、一步梯度；几百万步下来每个 t 都覆盖了。每张图走完 1000 个 t 会贵 1000 倍且毫无益处。生成时顺序不可避免：xₜ 去噪之前 xₜ₋₁ 还不存在。

A common misunderstanding: "training walks t = 1…1000 for each image" — it does not. In SD's training code it is one line, t = torch.randint(0, 1000, (batch_size,)), a different random t for every image in the batch. One image, one t, one loss, one gradient step; over millions of steps every t is covered. Walking all 1000 t's per image would cost 1000× more for nothing. In generation the order is unavoidable: xₜ₋₁ does not exist until xₜ is denoised.

为什么生成还要很多步（课堂思考题 3）：从纯噪声 x_T 出发，所有图像都一样可能，MSE 最优的预测是所有可能图像的平均——一团灰。网络无法一步「下定决心」。每步只去掉一点噪声、再注入一点新随机性，模型在这里做一个个小的、依次的决定（这是猫、橙色、朝左……）；大 t 定全局布局，小 t 定细纹理。类比 GPT：GPT 每个 token 做一个决定，扩散每步做一个（软的、全局的）决定。

Why generation needs many steps (Think about it 3): from pure noise x_T every image is equally plausible, and the MSE-optimal prediction is the average of all of them — a grey blur. The network cannot commit in one step. Each step removes a little noise and re-injects a little randomness, and here the model makes small sequential decisions (a cat, orange, facing left, …); large t decides the layout, small t the texture. Like GPT: GPT makes one decision per token, diffusion one soft global decision per step.

采样（生成）算法The sampling algorithm

xt−1=1αt(xt−βt1−αˉt ϵ^)+σtz,ϵ^=ϵθ(xt,t),z∼N(0,I),σ1=0x_{t-1} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_t}}\Bigl(x_t - \frac{\beta_t}{\sqrt{1-\bar\alpha_t}}\,\hat\epsilon\Bigr) + \sigma_t z,\qquad \hat\epsilon = \epsilon_\theta(x_t, t),\quad z\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I),\quad \sigma_1 = 0xt−1​=αt​​1​(xt​−1−αˉt​​βt​​ϵ^)+σt​z,ϵ^=ϵθ​(xt​,t),z∼N(0,I),σ1​=0

大白话：减掉一份缩放过的预测噪声，整体放大，再加一点新噪声。DDPM 每张图 1000 次网络调用，很慢；DDIM（Song 2021）等求解器跳步，20–50 次质量几乎一样，SD 默认约 50 步。每次调用都是大网络的一次完整前向，所以生成成本很重要——这正是下一节潜空间的动机。

In words: subtract a scaled copy of the predicted noise, rescale, add a bit of fresh noise. DDPM needs 1000 network calls per image — slow; DDIM (Song 2021) and other solvers skip steps, and 20–50 calls give almost the same quality; SD uses about 50 by default. Each call is a full forward pass of a large network, which motivates the latent space in the next section.

四点（像素空间、无条件）· Four parts (pixel space, unconditional)
结构Architecture 噪声预测器 ε_θ(xₜ, t)，输入带噪图 + t，输出同形状张量；DDPM 用 U-Netnoise predictor, same-shape output; DDPM uses a U-Net
损失Loss ∥ε − ε_θ(xₜ, t)∥²
数据Data 任意无标签图像，每张通过前向过程给出无限多 (xₜ, ε) 对any unlabelled images, each giving unlimited (xₜ, ε) pairs
优化器Optimizer Adam，lr 2 × 10⁻⁴（DDPM），采样用权重 EMAAdam, lr 2 × 10⁻⁴, EMA weights for sampling

还差两步才是 Stable Diffusion：每步处理 786,432 个数太贵 → 潜空间；还没有文本提示 → 交叉注意力。

Two problems remain before this is Stable Diffusion: diffusing 786,432 numbers per step is too expensive → latent space; there is no text prompt yet → cross-attention.

3. 潜空间：自编码器（VAE）Latent space: the autoencoder (VAE)

  • 像素空间太贵：每生成一张图，噪声预测器要处理 786,432 个值 50 次，而大部分值（草的纹理、传感器噪声、JPEG 级细节）感知上不重要。潜扩散模型（Rombach 等，CVPR 2022）把工作分成两半：预训练的自编码器负责压缩/解压和感知细节；扩散模型完全在小的潜空间里工作，负责语义。「Stable Diffusion」是这个想法的开源权重发布（Stability AI、CompVis、Runway，2022.8）。

    Pixel space is expensive: each generated image means processing 786,432 values 50 times, and most of them (grass texture, sensor noise, JPEG-level detail) are perceptually unimportant. Latent Diffusion Models (Rombach et al., CVPR 2022) split the work: a pre-trained autoencoder handles compression and perceptual detail; the diffusion model works entirely in the small latent space and handles semantics. "Stable Diffusion" is the open-weights release of this idea (Stability AI, CompVis, Runway, Aug 2022).

  • 编码器 E：512 × 512 × 3（786,432 个值）→ 潜变量 z：64 × 64 × 4（16,384 个值）；解码器 D 反过来。空间每个方向下采样 f = 8（512/8 = 64），通道 3 → 4，压缩 786,432/16,384 = 48 倍。自编码器在扩散之前预训练，扩散训练时冻结；反向过程结束（t = 0）后每张图调用一次解码器。

    Encoder E: 512 × 512 × 3 (786,432 values) → latent z: 64 × 64 × 4 (16,384 values); decoder D goes back. Down-sampling f = 8 per spatial direction (512/8 = 64), channels 3 → 4, compression 48×. The autoencoder is pre-trained before diffusion and frozen during diffusion training; one decoder call per image at the end (t = 0).

  • VAE 的直觉：把图挤过一根窄管（潜变量，小 48 倍）再重建。编码器输出均值 μ 和分布宽度 σ，解码器拿到 μ 附近的随机样本 z，所以它必须把一整片邻域都解码对：相近的潜变量给出相似的图像，没有断崖、没有空洞。KL 项把每个潜变量拉向标准高斯（中心 0、宽度约 1）；没有它编码器会把潜变量撒得到处都是（巨大的值、孤岛）。扩散恰好需要这样一个光滑、单位尺度、像高斯的空间——它往潜变量里加高斯噪声、最后从高斯噪声出发。SD 用 λ ≈ 10⁻⁶：整齐但不压扁。

    VAE intuition: squeeze the image through a narrow pipe (the latent, 48× smaller) and rebuild it. The encoder outputs a mean μ and a spread σ, and the decoder gets a random sample z near μ, so it must decode a whole neighbourhood correctly: nearby latents give similar images — no cliffs, no holes. The KL term pulls every latent toward a standard Gaussian (centre 0, spread about 1); without it the encoder could scatter latents anywhere (huge values, isolated islands). Diffusion needs exactly this smooth, unit-scale, Gaussian-like space, since it adds Gaussian noise to latents and starts from Gaussian noise. SD uses λ ≈ 10⁻⁶: tidy, not squashed.

LVAE=∥x−x^∥2⏟did you rebuild the same image?+λ KL(N(μ,σ2) ∥ N(0,I))⏟keep the latent space tidy,z=μ+σ⊙ϵ\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{VAE}} = \underbrace{\lVert x - \hat x\rVert^2}_{\text{did you rebuild the same image?}} + \lambda\,\underbrace{\mathrm{KL}\bigl(\mathcal{N}(\mu,\sigma^2)\,\Vert\,\mathcal{N}(0,I)\bigr)}_{\text{keep the latent space tidy}},\qquad z = \mu + \sigma\odot\epsilonLVAE​=did you rebuild the same image?∥x−x^∥2​​+λkeep the latent space tidyKL(N(μ,σ2)∥N(0,I))​​,z=μ+σ⊙ϵ

手算例题：VAE 一步训练（课件原题）· Worked example: one VAE training step

两像素图 x = (2.0, 1.0)，一维潜变量，λ = 0.01。编码器 μ = 0.5x₁ + 0.5x₂、另一个头给 σ = 0.5；解码器 x̂ = (az, bz)，a = 1.2，b = 0.6。

Two-pixel image x = (2.0, 1.0), a 1-number latent, λ = 0.01. Encoder μ = 0.5x₁ + 0.5x₂ and a second head giving σ = 0.5; decoder x̂ = (az, bz) with a = 1.2, b = 0.6.

  1. 编码：μ = 1.5，σ = 0.5。

    Encode: μ = 1.5, σ = 0.5.

  2. 采样 ε = 0.4：z = μ + σε = 1.7（重参数化技巧：z 对 μ、σ 可导）。

    Sample ε = 0.4: z = μ + σε = 1.7 (the reparameterisation trick makes z differentiable w.r.t. μ and σ).

  3. 解码：x̂ = (2.04, 1.02)；重建损失 0.0016 + 0.0004 = 0.002。

    Decode: x̂ = (2.04, 1.02); reconstruction loss 0.002.

  4. KL（一维高斯对 N(0, 1)）= ½(μ² + σ² − 1 − ln σ²) = ½(2.25 + 0.25 − 1 + 1.386) = 1.443（只有 μ = 0、σ = 1 时为 0）。总损失 0.002 + 0.01 × 1.443 = 0.0164。

    KL (1-D Gaussian vs N(0, 1)) = ½(μ² + σ² − 1 − ln σ²) = 1.443 (zero only at μ = 0, σ = 1). Total loss 0.002 + 0.01 × 1.443 = 0.0164.

  5. 反向：∂L/∂a = 2(x̂₁ − x₁)z = 2 × 0.04 × 1.7 = 0.136；∂L/∂μ：经由 z 的重建部分 2(0.04)(1.2) + 2(0.02)(0.6) = 0.12，KL 部分 λμ = 0.015，共 0.135。

    Backprop: ∂L/∂a = 2 × 0.04 × 1.7 = 0.136; ∂L/∂μ = 0.12 (reconstruction, through z) + 0.015 (KL, λμ) = 0.135.

  6. 更新（lr 0.1）：a → 1.2 − 0.0136 = 1.186，下次 x̂₁ = 2.02，更接近 2.0；μ 要减小，两项此时恰好一致。采样让解码器这次在 z = 1.7（而非 1.5）上训练，下次可能是 1.3，所以它学会解码一整片邻域，这就是潜空间光滑的原因。真实 VAE 还加 LPIPS 和 GAN 项，训好后冻结。

    Update (lr 0.1): a → 1.186, so next time x̂₁ = 2.02, closer to 2.0; μ should decrease, and both terms agree here. Sampling trained the decoder at z = 1.7 rather than 1.5 (next time maybe 1.3), so it learns a whole neighbourhood — that is what makes the latent space smooth. The real VAE adds LPIPS and GAN terms and is frozen once trained.

  • 潜空间的直觉：z 每个位置（4 维向量）概括一个 8 × 8 像素块（大致颜色、纹理、边的方向）；z 仍是 64 × 64 的「图」，卷积和注意力照样适用。之前所有公式换成对 z 做：z₀ = E(x₀)，zₜ = √ᾱₜ z₀ + √(1 − ᾱₜ) ε，L = ∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t)∥²；生成：从 z_T ~ N(0, I) ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4) 去噪 50 步到 z₀，再解码一次 x = D(z₀)。

    Latent intuition: each position of z (a 4-vector) summarises an 8 × 8 pixel patch (rough colour, texture, edge direction); z is still a 64 × 64 grid, so convolutions and attention still apply. All earlier formulas now act on z: z₀ = E(x₀), zₜ = √ᾱₜ z₀ + √(1 − ᾱₜ) ε, L = ∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t)∥²; generation: denoise z_T ~ N(0, I) ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4) for 50 steps to z₀, then decode once, x = D(z₀).

  • 为什么不压得更狠，比如 f = 32（课堂思考题 4）：解码器要从 z 重建全部像素细节。f = 32 时每个潜向量要用 4 个数编码 32 × 32 块（3,072 个值），重建会模糊，文字、人脸、细结构都丢。LDM 论文扫了 f ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}：4–8 最好；太小扩散慢、算力花在看不见的细节上；太大自编码器瓶颈封顶最终质量。SD 1.x/2.x：f = 8、4 通道（每个 8 × 8 块 192 个值用 4 个数概括）；SD3、Flux、Wan 仍 f = 8 但用 16 通道，管子宽 4 倍，细节保住，而扩散网格大小不变。设计规则：自编码器决定质量上限，扩散模型决定离上限多近。

    Why not compress harder, say f = 32 (Think about it 4): the decoder must rebuild all pixel detail from z. At f = 32 each latent vector encodes a 32 × 32 patch (3,072 values) with 4 numbers, so reconstructions blur and text, faces and fine structure are lost. The LDM paper swept f ∈ {1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32}: 4–8 was best; too small and diffusion is slow and wastes capacity on imperceptible detail, too large and the autoencoder caps the final quality. SD 1.x/2.x: f = 8 with 4 channels (192 values per 8 × 8 patch summarised by 4 numbers); SD3, Flux and Wan keep f = 8 but use 16 channels — a 4× wider pipe that keeps detail while the diffusion grid stays the same size. Design rule: the autoencoder sets the quality ceiling; the diffusion model decides how close you get.

4. 文本条件：每步都输入提示、交叉注意力、无分类器引导Text conditioning: prompt at every step, cross-attention, classifier-free guidance

  • 同一个提示在所有 T 步都输入噪声预测器：ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)。训练也没变：前向过程仍给标签 ε，损失 ∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)∥²，c 是训练图片的标题。

    The same prompt is fed to the noise predictor at all T steps: ε_θ(zₜ, t, c). Training is unchanged: the forward process still provides ε, the loss is ∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)∥², and c is the training image's caption.

  • 文本 → 向量：SD 1.x 用冻结的 CLIP ViT-L/14 文本编码器，提示最多 77 个 token，每个 768 维：c = CLIP_text(prompt) ∈ ℝ^(77×768)。CLIP 训练时把图像和它的标题放在相近的向量上，所以它的文本嵌入已经是「视觉化」的。文本编码器每个提示只跑一次、冻结，只训练噪声预测器。

    Text → vectors: SD 1.x uses the frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder; the prompt becomes at most 77 tokens of 768 dims: c = CLIP_text(prompt) ∈ ℝ^(77×768). CLIP was trained to place an image and its caption at nearby vectors, so its text embeddings are already "visual". The text encoder runs once per prompt and is frozen; only the noise predictor is trained.

  • 交叉注意力：和自注意力只差一点——Q 来自图像潜变量，K、V 来自文本。Q = H_img W_Q ∈ ℝ^(4096×d_k)（64 × 64 = 4,096 个位置），K = cW_K ∈ ℝ^(77×d_k)，V = cW_V ∈ ℝ^(77×d_v)；输出 4096 × d_v，每个图像位置一行，是 77 个文本 value 的加权平均（比如 0.5 看「red」、0.25 看「cat」）。

    Cross-attention differs from self-attention in one way: Q comes from the image latent, K and V from the text. Q = H_img W_Q ∈ ℝ^(4096×d_k) (64 × 64 = 4,096 positions), K = cW_K ∈ ℝ^(77×d_k), V = cW_V ∈ ℝ^(77×d_v); the output is 4096 × d_v, one row per image position, a weighted average of the 77 text value vectors (e.g. 0.5 on "red", 0.25 on "cat").

Attn(Q,K,V)=softmax(QK⊤dk)V,Q=HimgWQ,K=cWK,V=cWV\mathrm{Attn}(Q,K,V) = \mathrm{softmax}\Bigl(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}}\Bigr)V,\qquad Q = H_{\mathrm{img}}W_Q,\quad K = cW_K,\quad V = cW_VAttn(Q,K,V)=softmax(dk​​QK⊤​)V,Q=Himg​WQ​,K=cWK​,V=cWV​

手算例题：交叉注意力（课件原题）· Worked example: cross-attention

两个图像位置、三个文本 token（"a"、"red"、"cat"），d_k = d_v = 2。Q 的行 (1, 0)、(0, 1)；K 的行 (0, 0)、(1, 0)、(0, 1)；V 的行 (0, 0)、(1, 0)、(0, 1)。

Two image positions, three text tokens ("a", "red", "cat"), d_k = d_v = 2. Q rows (1, 0), (0, 1); K rows (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1); V rows (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1).

  • 位置 A：分数 q_A Kᵀ/√2 = (0, 0.707, 0)；softmax = (1, 2.03, 1)/4.03 = (0.25, 0.50, 0.25)；输出 0.25(0, 0) + 0.50(1, 0) + 0.25(0, 1) = (0.50, 0.25)。

    Position A: scores (0, 0.707, 0); softmax (0.25, 0.50, 0.25); output (0.50, 0.25).

  • 位置 B：对称地分数 (0, 0, 0.707)，权重 (0.25, 0.25, 0.50)，输出 (0.25, 0.50)。A 主要「听」red，B 主要「听」cat；输出加回图像潜变量，A 的特征往「红」移动、B 往「猫」移动。很多层、很多步之后，词就变成了图像中的区域。

    Position B: by symmetry scores (0, 0, 0.707), weights (0.25, 0.25, 0.50), output (0.25, 0.50). A listens mostly to red, B to cat; the output is added back to the latent, moving A toward "red-ness" and B toward "cat-ness". Over many layers and steps, words become regions of the image.

U-Net 里每个「Transformer 块」：自注意力（图像 ↔ 图像，QKV 都来自 H）→ 交叉注意力（图像 ← 文本，Q 来自 H，K、V 来自 c）→ 前馈 MLP；每个子块都是 H ← H + SubBlock(Norm(H))，和 GPT 一样。

Each "Transformer block" in the U-Net: self-attention (image ↔ image, Q, K, V from H) → cross-attention (image ← text, Q from H, K and V from c) → feed-forward MLP; every sub-block is H ← H + SubBlock(Norm(H)), exactly as in GPT.

课堂思考题 5：每步、每层的文本 c 都一样，重复算 K = cW_K、V = cW_V 浪费吗？为什么文本只能当 K/V 而不能当 Q？

Think about it 5: c is the same at every step and every layer — is recomputing K = cW_K and V = cW_V wasteful? Why must the text be keys/values rather than queries?

  • 缓存：是的，每层的文本 K、V 算一次、50 步复用（每层有自己的 W_K、W_V，所以每层一份缓存）；文本编码器每个提示跑一次。实际省得不多，因为交叉注意力比卷积和自注意力便宜，但实现里都会缓存。

    Caching: yes, each layer's text K and V can be computed once and reused for all 50 steps (each layer has its own W_K, W_V, so one cache per layer); the text encoder runs once per prompt. The saving is small because cross-attention is cheap next to convolutions and self-attention, but implementations do cache.

  • 方向：网络要输出和 zₜ 同形状的张量，即每个图像位置一个输出；注意力每个 query 产生一个输出，所以 query 必须是图像位置。反过来会得到 77 个输出（每个词一个），加不回 64 × 64 的潜变量。

    Direction: the network must output a tensor shaped like zₜ, one output per image position; attention gives one output per query, so the queries must be image positions. Swapping gives 77 outputs (one per word), which cannot be added back to a 64 × 64 latent.

无分类器引导（CFG）· Classifier-free guidance

  • 问题：照上面训练，要「a red cat on a bench」常得到一只普通的猫、可能没有长椅。噪声预测主要由「怎样才像一张合理的图」决定，提示只轻轻推一下。

    The problem: trained as above, "a red cat on a bench" often yields a generic cat, maybe no bench. The noise prediction is dominated by "what makes a plausible image"; the prompt only nudges it.

  • 想法（Ho & Salimans 2022）：每步在同一个 zₜ 上把同一个网络跑两次：带提示 ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)（「红猫图会往哪走」）和空提示 ε_θ(zₜ, t, ∅)（「一般的图会往哪走」）。两者之差正是提示造成的部分，把它放大 w 倍：

    The idea (Ho & Salimans 2022): at each step run the same network twice on the same zₜ — with the prompt, ε_θ(zₜ, t, c) ("where a red-cat image would go"), and with an empty prompt, ε_θ(zₜ, t, ∅) ("where a generic image would go"). Their difference is exactly the prompt's effect; go w times further in that direction:

ϵ^=ϵθ(zt,t,∅)+w(ϵθ(zt,t,c)−ϵθ(zt,t,∅))=(1−w) ϵθ(zt,t,∅)+w ϵθ(zt,t,c),w≈7.5\hat\epsilon = \epsilon_\theta(z_t,t,\varnothing) + w\bigl(\epsilon_\theta(z_t,t,c) - \epsilon_\theta(z_t,t,\varnothing)\bigr) = (1-w)\,\epsilon_\theta(z_t,t,\varnothing) + w\,\epsilon_\theta(z_t,t,c),\qquad w\approx 7.5ϵ^=ϵθ​(zt​,t,∅)+w(ϵθ​(zt​,t,c)−ϵθ​(zt​,t,∅))=(1−w)ϵθ​(zt​,t,∅)+wϵθ​(zt​,t,c),w≈7.5

  • 训练技巧：为了让「空提示」有意义，训练时以 10% 的概率把标题换成空字符串 ""。一个网络两份工作（有条件和无条件），不加参数。这一步只改变噪声预测器的第三个输入；前向过程造 zₜ 和标签 ε 时根本不看标题，t 和 ε 不变。对那 10% 的样本，预测器解的正是第 1 部分的无条件 DDPM 问题。

    Training trick: so that "empty prompt" means something, replace the caption with "" with probability 10% during training. One network, two jobs (conditional and unconditional), no extra parameters. Only the predictor's third input changes; the forward process that builds zₜ and the label ε never looks at the caption, and t and ε are untouched. For those 10% of samples the predictor solves exactly the unconditional DDPM problem.

  • 空提示不是「凭空造图」：任务始终是「复原」——输入 zₜ 已含图像的大部分，网络只猜噪声；提示是额外提示，去掉它就是少一个提示。小 t 时是真正的复原；大 t 时没什么可复原，只能编一张合理的图。生成 = 从纯噪声开始的复原。没有提示时学到的是「所有像 zₜ 的图」的平均复原方向，有「red cat」时是更窄的一组；这个差距在大 t 时最大，CFG 放大的就是它。

    An empty prompt is not "make an image from nothing": the task is always restoration — zₜ already contains most of the image and the network only guesses the noise; the prompt is an extra hint, and removing it leaves one hint fewer. At small t it is true restoration; at large t nothing is left, so the network invents a plausible image. Generation is restoration started from pure noise. Without a prompt the network learns the average restoration direction over all images that look like zₜ; with "red cat", over a narrower set. That gap is largest at large t, and it is what CFG amplifies.

手算例题：CFG 一步（课件原题）· Worked example: one CFG step

ε_θ(zₜ, t, ∅) = (0.20, 0.50)，ε_θ(zₜ, t, c) = (0.26, 0.44)，推力 = (0.06, −0.06)（很小，提示几乎没作用）；w = 7.5 ⇒ ε̂ = (0.20, 0.50) + 7.5 × (0.06, −0.06) = (0.65, 0.05)，现在提示主导。

ε_θ(zₜ, t, ∅) = (0.20, 0.50), ε_θ(zₜ, t, c) = (0.26, 0.44), nudge = (0.06, −0.06) (tiny: the prompt barely matters); w = 7.5 ⇒ ε̂ = (0.65, 0.05), and now the prompt dominates.

  • 名字：更早的 classifier guidance（Dhariwal & Nichol 2021）用一个单独图像分类器的梯度推，这个不需要分类器，所以叫 classifier-free。代价：每步 2 次前向。w 越大越贴合提示、多样性越低；w > 15 出现过饱和的「烧焦」图。

    Name: the earlier classifier guidance (Dhariwal & Nichol 2021) pushed with the gradient of a separate image classifier; this needs none — hence classifier-free. Cost: 2 forward passes per step. Larger w gives stronger prompt adherence and less diversity; w > 15 gives over-saturated "burnt" images.

  • 课堂思考题 6：为什么放大 7.5 倍不会变成垃圾？只放大两个几乎相同的预测之间的差，两者都同意的部分（合理的布局）仍是 1 倍；而且做 50 次，每次网络都重新读结果，错误下一步就能纠正。w = 0：完全忽略提示，得到无条件样本；w = 1：普通条件预测；w < 0：远离提示（很少用）。改写成 (1 − w)ε(∅) + wε(c)，w = 7.5 时空提示分支权重 −6.5，即远离空提示预测、朝带提示预测走（0.20 → 0.26 → 0.65）。界面里的「negative prompt」就是把空提示换成负面提示（「blurry, extra fingers」），保持 w = 7.5，于是远离负面提示。四点框架里 CFG 只改了训练数据（10% 空标题）和推理过程；结构、损失公式、优化器都没动。

    Think about it 6: why does a 7.5× push not produce garbage? It amplifies only the difference between two almost identical predictions; everything both agree on (a plausible layout) stays at 1×; and it is applied 50 times with the network re-reading the result, so errors are corrected next step. w = 0: the prompt is ignored, giving an unconditional sample; w = 1: the ordinary conditional prediction; w < 0: move away from the prompt (rare). Rewritten as (1 − w)ε(∅) + wε(c), w = 7.5 gives the empty-prompt branch weight −6.5: the step moves away from the empty-prompt prediction toward the prompted one (0.20 → 0.26 → 0.65). The "negative prompt" box replaces the empty prompt with the negative prompt ("blurry, extra fingers") and keeps w = 7.5, so the step moves away from it. In the four-part frame CFG changes only the training data (10% empty captions) and the inference procedure; architecture, loss formula and optimizer are untouched.

5. Stable Diffusion 的四个部分Stable Diffusion in four parts

推理全流程：提示 → CLIP 文本编码器（冻结，123M）→ c（77 × 768）作交叉注意力的 K、V；z_T ~ N(0, I)（64 × 64 × 4）→ U-Net ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)（860M）循环 t = T…1，50 步（CFG 时每步 ×2）→ z₀ → VAE 解码器 → 图像。三个网络分别训练，只有 U-Net 用扩散损失训练。

Inference pipeline: prompt → CLIP text encoder (frozen, 123M) → c (77 × 768) as the cross-attention K, V; z_T ~ N(0, I) (64 × 64 × 4) → U-Net ε_θ(zₜ, t, c) (860M) looped t = T…1 for 50 steps (×2 with CFG) → z₀ → VAE decoder → image. Three networks trained separately; only the U-Net is trained with the diffusion loss.

  • 结构：U-Net。输入 zₜ ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4)、t、c ∈ ℝ^(77×768)，输出 ε̂ ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4)。编码路径：卷积 ResNet 块，下采样 64 → 32 → 16 → 8，通道 320 → 640 → 1280 → 1280；解码路径镜像上采样回 64，跳跃连接在每个分辨率把编码器特征拷到解码器（这就是「U」）；在 64、32、16 分辨率插入 Transformer 块（自注意力 + 交叉注意力 + MLP）；t 经正弦嵌入 → MLP → 加进每个 ResNet 块。约 860M 参数。

    Architecture: U-Net. Input zₜ ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4), t, c ∈ ℝ^(77×768); output ε̂ ∈ ℝ^(64×64×4). Encoder path: conv ResNet blocks down-sampling 64 → 32 → 16 → 8 with channels 320 → 640 → 1280 → 1280; decoder path mirrors it back to 64, with skip connections copying encoder features across at each resolution (the "U"); Transformer blocks (self-attention + cross-attention + MLP) at resolutions 64, 32, 16; t goes through a sinusoidal embedding → MLP → added into every ResNet block. About 860M parameters.

  • 为什么用 U-Net：输出与输入同形状且空间对齐（位置 (i, j) 的噪声在 (i, j) 预测），U-Net 本来就是为这个设计的（2015 医学图像分割）；跳跃连接把精细空间细节送到解码器，瓶颈可以专心处理语义；卷积有很强的局部先验、高分辨率时便宜，注意力只在网格够小时用。为什么 2024–2025 都换成 Transformer：Diffusion Transformer（DiT，Peebles & Xie 2023）随算力和数据扩展更可预测，处理视频（多一条时间轴）也很自然——视频就是更长的 token 序列。SD3、Flux、Sora、Wan 都是 DiT。

    Why a U-Net: the output has the input's shape and must be spatially aligned (noise at (i, j) predicted at (i, j)), exactly what U-Nets were designed for (medical segmentation, 2015); skip connections carry fine detail to the decoder so the bottleneck can focus on semantics; convolutions give a strong locality prior and are cheap at high resolution, with attention only where the grid is small. Why everyone switched to Transformers in 2024–2025: Diffusion Transformers (DiT, Peebles & Xie 2023) scale more predictably with compute and data and handle video (an extra time axis) naturally — a video is just a longer token sequence. SD3, Flux, Sora and Wan are all DiTs.

  • 损失：L_SD = E[∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)∥²]，zₜ = √ᾱₜ E(x₀) + √(1 − ᾱₜ) ε，c = CLIP(caption)，10% 概率 c = CLIP("")。和 DDPM 损失一样，只是在潜变量上、加了条件输入。T = 1000，scaled-linear 表。此阶段没有对抗损失、感知损失、似然项，就是 MSE（VAE 有那些，但已冻结）。对比 GPT：GPT 对下一个词做交叉熵，SD 对加入的噪声做 MSE，都是「预测被藏起来的东西」。

    Loss: L_SD = E[∥ε − ε_θ(zₜ, t, c)∥²] with zₜ = √ᾱₜ E(x₀) + √(1 − ᾱₜ) ε, c = CLIP(caption), and c = CLIP("") with probability 10%. The DDPM loss on latents with a conditioning input. T = 1000, scaled-linear schedule. No adversarial, perceptual or likelihood term at this stage — just MSE (the VAE had those but is frozen). Versus GPT: GPT uses cross-entropy on the next token, SD uses MSE on the added noise; both "predict what was hidden".

  • 数据：LAION-5B，58.5 亿图文对，从 Common Crawl 抓取，按图像与 alt-text 的 CLIP 相似度过滤（alt-text 是网页作者写的 <img alt="...">，常常是商品名、文件名或 SEO 关键词，不是真正的描述）。SD 1.x 用英文子集：先在 laion2B-en（23 亿对）上以 256 × 256 训练，再在 laion-high-resolution（≥ 1024 px）和 laion-aesthetics v2 5+（约 6 亿对、美学分 ≥ 5、水印概率 < 0.5）上以 512 × 512 训练。模型「知道」的一切（猫长什么样、「梵高风格」是什么）都学自 alt-text 标题；标题弱 ⇒ 听提示的能力弱。后来的 DALL-E 3、SD3、Wan 用视觉语言模型重新写长而准确的标题：数据质量和结构一样重要。

    Data: LAION-5B, 5.85 billion image–text pairs scraped from Common Crawl, filtered by CLIP similarity between image and alt-text (the author-written <img alt="...">, often a product name, file name or SEO keywords rather than a description). SD 1.x uses English subsets: laion2B-en (2.3B pairs) at 256 × 256 first, then laion-high-resolution (≥ 1024 px) and laion-aesthetics v2 5+ (about 600M pairs, aesthetic score ≥ 5, watermark probability < 0.5) at 512 × 512. Everything the model "knows" comes from alt-text captions; weak captions mean weak prompt-following. Later models (DALL-E 3, SD3, Wan) re-caption images with a vision-language model: data quality matters as much as architecture.

  • 优化器：AdamW（β₁ = 0.9、β₂ = 0.999、权重衰减 0.01），lr 1 × 10⁻⁴（短线性 warm-up 后恒定），batch 2048 张，混合精度，256 张 A100（40 GB），约 15 万 A100 小时（256 张约 24 天），权重 EMA 衰减 0.9999 用于采样（明显比原始权重好，所有扩散模型的标配），先 256² 再 512²（先便宜地学粗结构，再细化）。

    Optimizer: AdamW (β₁ = 0.9, β₂ = 0.999, weight decay 0.01), lr 1 × 10⁻⁴ (short linear warm-up then constant), batch 2048 images, mixed precision, 256 A100s (40 GB), about 150,000 A100-hours (≈ 24 days on 256 GPUs), weight EMA with decay 0.9999 for sampling (noticeably better than the raw weights; standard for all diffusion models), 256² then 512² (learn coarse structure cheaply, then refine).

  • 推理配方：50 步 DDIM/PLMS，引导 w = 7.5，每步 2 次 U-Net，最后 1 次 VAE 解码；一张 GPU 几秒钟。

    Inference recipe: 50 DDIM/PLMS steps, guidance w = 7.5, 2 U-Net calls per step, 1 VAE decode; a few seconds on one GPU.

6. 视频：Wan 2.1Video: Wan 2.1

5 秒、16 fps、480 × 832 的视频有 81 帧：81 × 480 × 832 × 3 ≈ 9,700 万个值，是一张 512² 图的 120 倍。新问题：压缩还要压时间轴；时间一致（第 40 帧的猫和第 1 帧是同一只），注意力必须跨帧；运动要符合物理（物体持续存在、平滑运动、遮挡正确）。

A 5-second, 16 fps, 480 × 832 clip has 81 frames: 81 × 480 × 832 × 3 ≈ 97 million values, 120× a 512² image. New problems: compression must also squeeze time; temporal consistency (the cat in frame 40 is the cat in frame 1) means attention must span frames; motion must be physical (objects persist, move smoothly, occlude correctly).

  • Wan-VAE（3D 因果自编码器）：输入 81 × 480 × 832 × 3；压缩 4 × 8 × 8（时间 ÷4、高 ÷8、宽 ÷8），通道 3 → 16。第一帧只做空间压缩，所以 81 帧 → 1 + 80/4 = 21 个潜帧（因此 Wan 的视频长度都是 4k + 1 帧）。潜变量 16 × 21 × 60 × 104 ≈ 210 万个值，对比像素 9,700 万，约 46 倍压缩（接近 SD 的 48 倍，但在 3D 里）。为什么因果：编码器的 3D 卷积只看当前和过去的帧 ⇒ 单张图就是合法的 1 帧视频（一个 VAE 同时服务图像和视频，图像数据也能用来训练）；长视频可以一块一块流式处理、内存恒定。单独训练（重建 + 感知 + KL，再对抗微调）后冻结，作用和 SD 的 VAE 一样。

    Wan-VAE (3D causal autoencoder): input 81 × 480 × 832 × 3; compression 4 × 8 × 8 (time ÷4, height ÷8, width ÷8), channels 3 → 16. The first frame is compressed only spatially, so 81 frames → 1 + 80/4 = 21 latent frames (hence Wan clips have 4k + 1 frames). Latent 16 × 21 × 60 × 104 ≈ 2.1M values vs 97M pixels, about 46× (close to SD's 48×, but in 3D). Why causal: its 3D convolutions see only current and past frames ⇒ a single image is a valid 1-frame video (one VAE for images and videos, so images become training data), and long videos stream chunk by chunk in constant memory. Trained separately (reconstruction + perceptual + KL, then adversarial fine-tuning) and frozen, like SD's VAE.

  • 从潜变量到 token：DiT 像 GPT 一样需要 token 序列。用 1 × 2 × 2（时×高×宽）的 patch 切：16 × 21 × 60 × 104 → 21 × 30 × 52 = 32,760 个 token，每个 token 含 16 × 1 × 2 × 2 = 64 个值，经线性层映射到模型宽度 d。对比：GPT-3 上下文 2,048，SD 的 U-Net 注意力 4,096 个位置；Wan 在 32,760 个跨空间和时间的 token 上做全自注意力，每帧每块都能看到其他所有块。注意力代价 ∝ 32,760² ≈ 10⁹ 对/层/头，是视频生成的主要算力，所以训练要用序列并行。位置信息用 3D RoPE（t、h、w 各一组频率）。直觉：一个 token ≈ 连续 4 帧里的一个 16 × 16 像素块（「这块大多是毛，稍微往左动」），DiT 在这些概括上推理，VAE 解码器负责画像素。

    From latent to tokens: the DiT needs a token sequence like GPT. Patchify with 1 × 2 × 2 (T × H × W): 16 × 21 × 60 × 104 → 21 × 30 × 52 = 32,760 tokens, each packing 16 × 1 × 2 × 2 = 64 values, mapped by a linear layer to width d. Compare GPT-3's 2,048-token context and SD's 4,096 U-Net positions: Wan runs full self-attention over 32,760 tokens spanning space and time. Attention cost ∝ 32,760² ≈ 10⁹ pairs per layer per head — the main compute cost, hence sequence parallelism. Positions use 3D RoPE (separate frequency bands for t, h, w). Intuition: one token ≈ a 16 × 16 pixel patch over 4 consecutive frames ("mostly fur, moving slightly left"); the DiT reasons about these summaries and the VAE decoder paints pixels.

  • DiT 块：GPT 风格的块加两点：① 对全部 32,760 个视频 token 的双向自注意力（无因果掩码）；② 对 umT5 文本 token 的交叉注意力（Q 来自视频，K、V 来自 c ∈ ℝ^(512×4096)），和 SD 机制完全一样，只是读 512 个而不是 77 个文本 token；③ 前馈 MLP；④ t 通过自适应 LayerNorm 进入（MLP 把 t 映射成每块的 scale/shift，DiT 风格），取代 SD 的「加到 ResNet 块」。为什么用 umT5 不用 CLIP：双向、多语言（中英）、512 token 能写长而详细的提示，帮助 Wan 在视频里写出可读的文字。

    DiT block: a GPT-style block plus (1) bidirectional self-attention over all 32,760 video tokens (no causal mask), (2) cross-attention to the umT5 text tokens (Q from video, K and V from c ∈ ℝ^(512×4096)) — exactly SD's mechanism, reading 512 text tokens instead of 77, (3) a feed-forward MLP, (4) t entering through adaptive LayerNorm (an MLP maps t to per-block scale/shift, DiT style) instead of SD's "add to the ResNet block". Why umT5 rather than CLIP: bidirectional, multilingual (Chinese + English), 512 tokens for long detailed prompts, which helps Wan render legible text in video.
