课堂思考题 7：为什么 GPT 要因果掩码，Wan 的 DiT 跨时间也不用？· Think about it 7: why GPT needs a causal mask but Wan's DiT does not

  • GPT 从左到右一次生成一个 token，训练时目标（下一个 token）就在输入里，位置 i 看到将来就会学会抄答案。

    GPT generates left to right, one token at a time; at training time the target (the next token) sits in the input, so if position i could see the future it would learn to copy the answer.

  • 扩散一次生成所有 token、迭代很多步，没有「将来」可泄露：第 t 步所有 token 噪声一样多，目标是噪声，输入里没有干净形式的答案。

    Diffusion generates all tokens at once over many steps; there is no future to leak: every token is equally noisy at step t, and the target is the noise, which the input does not contain in clean form.

  • 而且必须全注意力：第 40 帧要看第 1 帧以保持同一只猫，第 1 帧也要看第 40 帧，运动才能前后一致地规划。因果 DiT（CausVid、MAGI-1）也存在，用一致性换流式输出。

    And full attention is needed: frame 40 must look at frame 1 to keep the same cat, and frame 1 at frame 40 so motion is planned consistently. Causal DiTs exist (CausVid, MAGI-1), trading consistency for streaming output.

  • VAE 因果而 DiT 不因果，因为工作不同：VAE 是压缩器（局部工作），因果让一个 VAE 同时处理图像和视频、能流式处理任意长度（像 KV 缓存），代价是重建质量略降；DiT 是导演（全局工作），需要双向规划。

    The VAE is causal and the DiT is not because their jobs differ: the VAE is a compressor (local job), and causality lets one VAE handle images and videos and stream any length (like a KV cache) at a small cost in reconstruction; the DiT is the director (global job) and needs planning in both directions.

Flow matching：Wan 的损失Flow matching: Wan's loss

Wan 用 flow matching 代替 DDPM 的噪声预测：思想相同，代数更简单。时间连续 t ∈ [0, 1]：t = 0 干净数据，t = 1 纯噪声（注意和 DDPM 的编号方向相同、但 z₁ 在这里是纯噪声）。从数据到噪声走一条直线：

Wan replaces DDPM's noise prediction with flow matching: same idea, simpler algebra. Time is continuous, t ∈ [0, 1]: t = 0 is clean data and t = 1 is pure noise (here z₁ is pure noise, unlike DDPM's x₁). Noising follows a straight line from data to noise:

zt=(1−t) z0+t ϵ,ϵ∼N(0,I) ⟹ v⋆=dztdt=ϵ−z0,LFM=E[∥vθ((1−t)z0+tϵ, t, c)−(ϵ−z0)∥2]z_t = (1-t)\,z_0 + t\,\epsilon,\quad \epsilon\sim\mathcal{N}(0,I)\ \Longrightarrow\ v^\star = \frac{dz_t}{dt} = \epsilon - z_0,\qquad \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}} = \mathbb{E}\Bigl[\bigl\lVert v_\theta\bigl((1-t)z_0 + t\epsilon,\ t,\ c\bigr) - (\epsilon - z_0)\bigr\rVert^2\Bigr]zt​=(1−t)z0​+tϵ,ϵ∼N(0,I) ⟹ v⋆=dtdzt​​=ϵ−z0​,LFM​=E[​vθ​((1−t)z0​+tϵ, t, c)−(ϵ−z0​)​2]

  • v_θ(zₜ, t, c) 就是 DiT 本身（θ = 全部 1.3B/14B 参数），输入输出同形状 16 × 21 × 60 × 104，和 SD 的 ε_θ 一样；输出被读作速度 ε − z₀ 的猜测（「从 zₜ 往哪走是噪声」，取反就是往干净数据的方向）。只是目标的名字变了：SD 猜 ε，Wan 猜 ε − z₀。训练时 t 从偏向高噪声的 shifted logit-normal 分布抽。

    v_θ(zₜ, t, c) is the DiT itself (θ = all 1.3B/14B parameters), with input and output shape 16 × 21 × 60 × 104 like SD's ε_θ; its output is read as a guess of the velocity ε − z₀ ("which way from zₜ is toward the noise"; flip the sign for the way to clean data). Only the name of the target changed: SD guesses ε, Wan guesses ε − z₀. Training draws t from a shifted logit-normal that over-weights high noise.

  • 生成：从 z₁ ~ N(0, I) 开始，N 步、步长 Δ = 1/N 的 Euler 法：zₜ₋Δ = zₜ − Δ·v_θ(zₜ, t, c)（逆着预测的速度走一小步）。真实路径是直线，所以 N = 50（蒸馏后 4 步）就够。

    Generation: start at z₁ ~ N(0, I) and take N Euler steps of size Δ = 1/N: zₜ₋Δ = zₜ − Δ·v_θ(zₜ, t, c) ("move a little against the predicted velocity"). The true path is straight, so N = 50 (or 4 after distillation) is enough.

  • 它仍是噪声预测器：由 zₜ = (1 − t)z₀ + tε 和 v = ε − z₀ 得 ε = zₜ + (1 − t)v，z₀ = zₜ − tv；ε、z₀、v 三个目标信息相同，只是单位不同。

    It is still a noise predictor: from zₜ = (1 − t)z₀ + tε and v = ε − z₀ we get ε = zₜ + (1 − t)v and z₀ = zₜ − tv; the three targets carry the same information in different units.

手算例题：一维 flow matching（课件原题）· Worked example: one-number flow matching

z₀ = 1.0，ε = −0.5，t = 0.4 ⇒ zₜ = 0.6 × 1.0 + 0.4 × (−0.5) = 0.4；真速度 v* = −0.5 − 1.0 = −1.5。DiT 输出 v̂ = −1.2 ⇒ 损失 (−1.2 + 1.5)² = 0.09。生成一步（Δ = 0.1）：z₀.₃ = 0.4 − 0.1 × (−1.2) = 0.52，离数据 1.0 近了一步。换算：ε̂ = 0.4 + 0.6 × (−1.2) = −0.32（真值 −0.5），ẑ₀ = 0.4 − 0.4 × (−1.2) = 0.88（真值 1.0）——速度的猜测就是噪声的猜测。

z₀ = 1.0, ε = −0.5, t = 0.4 ⇒ zₜ = 0.4; true velocity v* = −1.5. The DiT outputs v̂ = −1.2 ⇒ loss 0.09. One generation step (Δ = 0.1): z₀.₃ = 0.4 + 0.12 = 0.52, one step closer to the data 1.0. Converting: ε̂ = 0.4 + 0.6 × (−1.2) = −0.32 (true −0.5), ẑ₀ = 0.4 + 0.48 = 0.88 (true 1.0) — a velocity guess is a noise guess.

训练与生成各用几个 t（课堂思考题 8）· How many t's in training vs generation (Think about it 8)

模型Model 训练：每次访问training per visit 训练：E 个 epoch 内over E epochs 生成：网络调用次数generation calls
DDPM (2020) 1 E 1000
Stable Diffusion 1.x 1 E 50（PLMS/DDIM）；多数界面 20；蒸馏 420 in most UIs; 4 distilled
Wan 2.1 1 E 50 / 40

例：Wan 在 N = 2 亿条视频上训练，batch B = 512，E = 3 个 epoch（每个 epoch 打乱一次、每条访问一次），每条视频各自抽一个随机 t 和 ε。

Example: Wan trains on N = 200 million clips, batch B = 512, E = 3 epochs (one shuffle per epoch, each clip visited once), each clip drawing its own random t and ε.

  1. 每次参数更新抽 512 个 t（batch 里每条一个，互相独立；代码 t = torch.rand(512)），不是整批共用一个 t，也不是每条走遍所有 t。

    Per update: 512 values of t (one per clip, independent; t = torch.rand(512)), not one shared t and not all t's per clip.

  2. 更新次数 = N·E/B = 2 × 10⁸ × 3/512 ≈ 117 万次。

    Updates = N·E/B ≈ 1.17 million.

  3. 总共抽 N·E = 6 亿个 t（每个（视频, 访问）一个），同样数量的噪声张量 ε，每个形状 16 × 21 × 60 × 104。

    Total t's = N·E = 600 million (one per clip-visit), with as many noise tensors of shape 16 × 21 × 60 × 104.

  4. 某一条视频只得到 E = 3 个 t（比如 0.93、0.41、0.12）；对 [0, 1] 的覆盖来自整个数据集的 6 亿次抽样。（若 batch 有放回抽样，访问次数随机，平均仍 3 次，约 e⁻³ ≈ 5% 的视频一次也没被访问。）

    One clip gets exactly E = 3 values of t (say 0.93, 0.41, 0.12); coverage of [0, 1] comes from 600 million draws across the dataset. (With replacement, visits are random, averaging 3, and about e⁻³ ≈ 5% of clips are never visited.)

  5. 若是 SD（t ∈ {1, …, 1000}），t = 537 这一个值约被用 6 × 10⁸/1000 = 60 万次，每次是不同的图、不同的 ε。

    For SD (t ∈ {1, …, 1000}), t = 537 alone is used about 600,000 times, each on a different image with a different ε.

对比推理：生成一段视频按顺序用 t = 1, 0.98, …, 0.02，50 次网络调用，t 没有随机性。训练用随机 t，生成用有序 t；SD 和 Wan 都一样。生成步数 N 在生成时选（速度 vs 质量），不用重训：SD 在 1000 个值的表里跨步（N = 50 时每 20 个取 1），Wan 在 [0, 1] 里取 N 个点。

Contrast with inference: generating one video uses t = 1, 0.98, …, 0.02 in order, 50 calls, no randomness in t. Random t for training, ordered t for generation, for both SD and Wan. N is chosen at generation time (speed vs quality) with no retraining: SD strides through the 1000-entry table (every 20th for N = 50), Wan picks N points in [0, 1].

  • Wan 的数据（技术报告里数据的篇幅比结构还多）：① 原始池：数十亿图像和视频；② 基础过滤：分辨率、时长、宽高比、帧率、去重；③ 质量过滤：美学分、模糊、水印、文字叠加、运动幅度，在镜头切换处切片；④ 标题：自研视觉语言模型给每段写稠密标题（物体、动作、镜头运动、风格），网页 alt-text 不作主要标题；⑤ 课程：先低分辨率的图像 + 短片，再提高分辨率（256 → 480 → 720p）和时长，最后在最高质量子集上训练。两个教训：图像也是视频训练数据（VAE 把图像当 1 帧视频：外观从便宜的图像学，运动从稀缺的视频学）；标题决定听提示的上限（标题里写了光照、镜头运动、风格，提示才能控制它们）。

    Wan's data (the report spends more pages on data than on architecture): (1) raw pool of billions of images and videos; (2) basic filtering — resolution, duration, aspect ratio, frame rate, dedupe; (3) quality filtering — aesthetics, blur, watermark, text overlay, motion magnitude, segmentation at scene cuts; (4) captioning — an in-house vision-language model writes dense captions (objects, actions, camera motion, style), and web alt-text is not the main caption; (5) curriculum — low-resolution images + short clips first, then higher resolution (256 → 480 → 720p) and duration, then a final stage on the best subset. Two lessons: images are video training data (the VAE treats an image as a 1-frame video, so appearance is learned from cheap images and motion from scarce videos); captions set the prompt-following ceiling (a prompt can control lighting, camera motion and style only if the captions named them).

  • 优化器与系统：AdamW + bf16 混合精度，学习率阶段配合数据课程，推理用权重 EMA——和 SD、GPT 同一家族。难点是并行而不是优化器：14B DiT 配 32,760 token 的序列放不进一张 GPU。FSDP 把参数、梯度、优化器状态切到多张 GPU；上下文（序列）并行（Ulysses + Ring attention）把 32,760 个 token 切到多张 GPU，每张只持有一段，注意力仍精确计算。推理：50 步、引导 w ≈ 5–6；14B 在一张高端 GPU 上生成 5 秒 720p 要几分钟；1.3B 能放进 8 GB。规模化既是建模问题也是系统问题：更新规则 2015 年以来没变，变的是张量怎么摆到几百张 GPU 上。

    Optimizer and systems: AdamW + bf16 mixed precision, learning-rate stages matched to the data curriculum, weight EMA for inference — the same family as SD and GPT. The hard part is parallelism, not the optimizer: a 14B DiT with 32,760-token sequences does not fit on one GPU. FSDP shards parameters, gradients and optimizer states across GPUs; context (sequence) parallelism (Ulysses + Ring attention) splits the 32,760 tokens across GPUs, each holding a slice, while attention is still computed exactly. Inference: 50 steps, guidance w ≈ 5–6; the 14B model takes minutes per 5-second 720p clip on one high-end GPU; the 1.3B model fits in 8 GB. Scaling is a systems problem as much as a modelling one: the update rule has not changed since 2015; what changed is how tensors are placed across hundreds of GPUs.

7. 要点Key takeaways

  1. 生成 = 迭代去噪。前向过程用固定公式加噪、白送标签；噪声预测器学会撤销一步；测试时从噪声出发用它 20–50 次。

    Generation is iterative denoising: the forward process adds noise with a fixed formula and gives free labels; the noise predictor learns to undo one step; at test time apply it 20–50 times starting from noise.

  2. 损失就是对一个能免费精确算出的量做 MSE，所以扩散训练稳定，GAN 不稳定。

    The loss is MSE on a quantity computed exactly for free, which is why diffusion trains stably where GANs did not.

  3. 潜空间让它负担得起：冻结的 VAE 把问题缩小约 48 倍，扩散模型从不看像素。

    Latent space makes it affordable: a frozen VAE shrinks the problem about 48×; the diffusion model never sees pixels.

  4. 提示每步都通过交叉注意力进入：图像（或视频）位置是 query，文本 token 是 key 和 value。和 GPT 同一个公式，K、V 来源不同。

    The prompt enters at every step through cross-attention: image (or video) positions are queries, text tokens are keys and values — GPT's equation with a different source for K, V.

  5. 无分类器引导在条件和无条件预测之间外推，放大提示的作用。

    Classifier-free guidance extrapolates between conditional and unconditional predictions to amplify the prompt.

  6. 视频 = 更长的 token 序列：3D VAE + 全时空注意力的 Transformer 去噪器把图像配方变成视频配方，新增的主要成本是约 3.3 万 token 上的注意力。

    Video = a longer token sequence: a 3D VAE and a Transformer denoiser with full space-time attention turn the image recipe into a video recipe; the main new cost is attention over about 33k tokens.

  7. 每次都是四个部分：结构、损失、数据、优化器，SD 和 Wan 的每一格现在你都能解释。

    Four parts every time: architecture, loss, data, optimizer — for SD and Wan you can now explain every box.

Lecture 12 Quiz 答案与关键步骤Lecture 12 Quiz answers and key steps

  • Q1 两步前向扩散的总噪声（β₁ = 9/25、β₂ = 7/16，ε₁ = (2/3, −2/3)，ε₂ = (2/√7, 2/√7)，x₂ = (1.7, −0.1)）：

    Q1 aggregate noise over two forward steps (β₁ = 9/25, β₂ = 7/16, ε₁ = (2/3, −2/3), ε₂ = (2/√7, 2/√7), x₂ = (1.7, −0.1)):

    • α₁ = 16/25、α₂ = 9/16 ⇒ ᾱ₂ = 9/25 = 0.36，√ᾱ₂ = 0.6，√(1 − ᾱ₂) = 0.8，即 x₂ = 0.6x₀ + 0.8ε。

      α₁ = 16/25, α₂ = 9/16 ⇒ ᾱ₂ = 0.36, so x₂ = 0.6x₀ + 0.8ε.

    • 代入展开：x₂ = √(α₂α₁)x₀ + √(α₂β₁)ε₁ + √β₂ε₂；第一步的噪声也被第二步缩放。√(α₂β₁)ε₁ = (9/20)(2/3, −2/3) = (0.3, −0.3)，√β₂ε₂ = (√7/4)(2/√7, 2/√7) = (0.5, 0.5)；噪声总贡献 (0.8, 0.2)。

      Expanding: x₂ = √(α₂α₁)x₀ + √(α₂β₁)ε₁ + √β₂ε₂; the first noise is scaled by the second step too. The two contributions are (0.3, −0.3) and (0.5, 0.5), total (0.8, 0.2).

    • 0.8ε = (0.8, 0.2) ⇒ ε = (1, 0.25)；x₀ = [(1.7, −0.1) − (0.8, 0.2)]/0.6 = (1.5, −0.5)。ε₂ 单独不能作 t = 2 的目标：它漏掉了第一步的噪声。

      0.8ε = (0.8, 0.2) ⇒ ε = (1, 0.25); x₀ = (1.5, −0.5). ε₂ alone cannot be the t = 2 target: it omits the first-step noise.

  • Q2 潜扩散中噪声预测的一次更新（ᾱₜ = 0.36，ε̂ = wzₜ + b，w = 0.25、b = 0.10、η = 0.20）：

    Q2 one noise-prediction update in latent diffusion (ᾱₜ = 0.36, ε̂ = wzₜ + b, w = 0.25, b = 0.10, η = 0.20):

    • zₜ = 0.6z₀ + 0.8ε：zₜ⁽¹⁾ = 0.6(2, −1) + 0.8(1, 0.5) = (2, −0.2)；zₜ⁽²⁾ = 0.6(−2, 1) + 0.8(−1, 0.5) = (−2, 1)。

      zₜ⁽¹⁾ = (2, −0.2), zₜ⁽²⁾ = (−2, 1).

    • ε̂⁽¹⁾ = (0.60, 0.05)，ε̂⁽²⁾ = (−0.40, 0.35)；误差 e = ε̂ − ε：e⁽¹⁾ = (−0.40, −0.45)，e⁽²⁾ = (0.60, −0.15)。

      ε̂⁽¹⁾ = (0.60, 0.05), ε̂⁽²⁾ = (−0.40, 0.35); errors e⁽¹⁾ = (−0.40, −0.45), e⁽²⁾ = (0.60, −0.15).

    • g_w = ½[(−0.4)(2) + (−0.45)(−0.2) + (0.6)(−2) + (−0.15)(1)] = −1.03；g_b = ½(−0.4 − 0.45 + 0.6 − 0.15) = −0.20。

      g_w = −1.03, g_b = −0.20.

    • (w, b) = (0.25 + 0.206, 0.10 + 0.04) = (0.456, 0.140)。VAE 冻结，只更新预测器。

      (w, b) = (0.456, 0.140); the VAE stays frozen.

  • Q3 交叉注意力与文本缓存（q₁ = (√2, 0)、q₂ = (√2, √2)；k = (ln 2, 0)、(0, ln 3)、(ln 2, ln 3)；v = (2, −1)、(−1, 2)、(1, 0)；25 步，K/V 投影每步 2 ms，其他 18 ms）：

    Q3 cross-attention and text caching (q₁ = (√2, 0), q₂ = (√2, √2); k = (ln 2, 0), (0, ln 3), (ln 2, ln 3); v = (2, −1), (−1, 2), (1, 0); 25 steps, K/V projections 2 ms per step, other work 18 ms):

    • 缩放分数：s₁ = (ln 2, 0, ln 2)，s₂ = (ln 2, ln 3, ln 6) ⇒ 权重 a₁ = (2, 1, 2)/5，a₂ = (2, 3, 6)/11。

      Scaled scores: s₁ = (ln 2, 0, ln 2), s₂ = (ln 2, ln 3, ln 6) ⇒ weights a₁ = (2, 1, 2)/5, a₂ = (2, 3, 6)/11.

    • o₁ = ((4 − 1 + 2)/5, (−2 + 2 + 0)/5) = (1, 0)；o₂ = ((4 − 3 + 6)/11, (−2 + 6)/11) = (7/11, 4/11)。

      o₁ = (1, 0); o₂ = (7/11, 4/11).

    • 提示和权重固定 ⇒ 每层文本 K、V 固定，每层一份缓存，图像 query 仍每步变化。不缓存 25 × 20 = 500 ms；缓存 2 + 25 × 18 = 452 ms；省 48 ms，即 9.6%。

      Fixed prompt and weights ⇒ each layer's text K, V are fixed (one cache per layer; image queries still change). Without caching 500 ms; with caching 2 + 25 × 18 = 452 ms; 48 ms saved, 9.6%.

  • Q4 CFG 一次反向更新（zₜ = (8/5, 4/5)，u = (1, −1)，c = (2, 1)，αₜ = 16/25，βₜ = 9/25，ᾱₜ = 19/100，w = 5/2）：

    Q4 one reverse update with CFG (zₜ = (8/5, 4/5), u = (1, −1), c = (2, 1), αₜ = 16/25, βₜ = 9/25, ᾱₜ = 19/100, w = 5/2):

    • c − u = (1, 2) ⇒ ε̂ = (1, −1) + 2.5(1, 2) = (7/2, 4)。

      c − u = (1, 2) ⇒ ε̂ = (7/2, 4).

    • 1/√αₜ = 5/4，βₜ/√(1 − ᾱₜ) = (9/25)/(9/10) = 2/5 ⇒ zₜ₋₁ = (5/4)zₜ − (5/4)(2/5)ε̂ = (5/4)zₜ − (1/2)ε̂ = (2, 1) − (7/4, 2) = (1/4, −1)（随机项取 0，即反向均值）。

      1/√αₜ = 5/4, βₜ/√(1 − ᾱₜ) = 2/5 ⇒ zₜ₋₁ = (5/4)zₜ − (1/2)ε̂ = (1/4, −1) (random term zero: the reverse mean).

    • 为什么越过 c：ε̂ = u + 2.5(c − u) = c + 1.5(c − u)；w = 1 恰好到 c，w > 1 就沿 u → c 的方向越过 c。

      Why it goes beyond c: ε̂ = c + 1.5(c − u); w = 1 lands exactly on c, so w > 1 overshoots c along the u → c direction.

  • Q5 Wan 视频长度与注意力存储（33 帧、256 × 384、16 通道、空间 ÷8；1 × 2 × 2 patch；12 头各存 N × N 分数矩阵，每个 2 字节，预算 600 MiB）：

    Q5 Wan video length and attention storage (33 frames, 256 × 384, 16 channels, spatial ÷8; 1 × 2 × 2 patches; 12 heads each storing an N × N score matrix at 2 bytes, budget 600 MiB):

    • 潜帧 1 + 32/4 = 9，高 32、宽 48 ⇒ 潜变量 16 × 9 × 32 × 48；每个潜帧 (32/2)(48/2) = 384 个 token ⇒ N = 3,456（通道是 patch 内的特征，不是额外 token）。

      Latent frames 1 + 32/4 = 9, height 32, width 48 ⇒ 16 × 9 × 32 × 48; 384 tokens per latent frame ⇒ N = 3,456 (channels are features inside a patch, not extra tokens).

    • T = 4k + 1 时潜帧 k + 1，N = 384(k + 1)；存储 = 12 × 2 × N² 字节 = 3.375(k + 1)² MiB ≤ 600 ⇒ k + 1 ≤ 40/3 ≈ 13.3 ⇒ 最多 13 个潜帧，k = 12。

      For T = 4k + 1: k + 1 latent frames, N = 384(k + 1); storage 12 × 2 × N² bytes = 3.375(k + 1)² MiB ≤ 600 ⇒ k + 1 ≤ 13.3 ⇒ at most 13 latent frames, k = 12.

    • 最多 T = 49 帧（N = 4,992，570.375 MiB）；下一个 53 帧要 3.375 × 14² = 661.5 MiB，超预算。

      Maximum T = 49 frames (N = 4,992, 570.375 MiB); the next allowed length, 53 frames, needs 661.5 MiB — over budget.

  • Q6 flow matching 与一步反向采样（t = 0.6，z₀.₆ = (0.2, 1.4)，ε = (−1, 3)，v̂ = (−2.5, 3)，Δ = 0.2）：

    Q6 flow matching and one reverse sampling step (t = 0.6, z₀.₆ = (0.2, 1.4), ε = (−1, 3), v̂ = (−2.5, 3), Δ = 0.2):

    • z₀ = [z₀.₆ − 0.6ε]/0.4 = [(0.2, 1.4) − (−0.6, 1.8)]/0.4 = (2, −1)。

      z₀ = [(0.2, 1.4) − (−0.6, 1.8)]/0.4 = (2, −1).

    • v* = ε − z₀ = (−3, 4)；误差 v̂ − v* = (0.5, −1) ⇒ L = 0.25 + 1 = 1.25（题目要求求和，不除以 2）。

      v* = (−3, 4); error (0.5, −1) ⇒ L = 1.25 (sum, not mean).

    • Euler：z₀.₄ = z₀.₆ − 0.2v̂ = (0.2, 1.4) − (−0.5, 0.6) = (0.7, 0.8)。

      Euler: z₀.₄ = (0.2, 1.4) − (−0.5, 0.6) = (0.7, 0.8).

L12 易错点L12 common mistakes

  • 前向过程没有可学参数；噪声表 βₜ 是手选的；唯一可训练的是噪声预测器（U-Net 或 DiT）。VAE 和文本编码器在扩散训练时冻结。

    The forward process has no learnable parameters; the schedule βₜ is hand-chosen; the only trainable part is the noise predictor (U-Net or DiT). The VAE and text encoder are frozen during diffusion training.

  • 网络预测的是噪声（SD）或速度 ε − z₀（Wan），不是干净图像；标签是前向过程里我们自己采样的噪声。

    The network predicts the noise (SD) or the velocity ε − z₀ (Wan), not the clean image; the label is the noise we sampled ourselves in the forward process.

  • 一步跳到 t 的公式里 ε 是总噪声，不是最后一步的 εₜ；ᾱₜ 是所有 αₛ 的乘积，不是 1 − βₜ。

    In the jump-to-t formula ε is the aggregate noise, not the last step's εₜ; ᾱₜ is the product of all αₛ, not 1 − βₜ.

  • 训练时每个样本一个随机 t；只有生成时 t 按顺序走 T → 1。

    Training uses one random t per sample; only generation walks t in order from T to 1.

  • 交叉注意力：Q 来自图像，K、V 来自文本；输出行数 = 图像位置数。文本 K、V 每层缓存一份，50 步复用。

    Cross-attention: Q from the image, K and V from the text; output rows = image positions. Text K, V are cached once per layer and reused for all steps.

  • CFG：ε̂ = u + w(c − u)；w = 0 无条件、w = 1 普通条件、w > 1 越过 c；训练时 10% 空标题，每步 2 次前向。

    CFG: ε̂ = u + w(c − u); w = 0 unconditional, w = 1 plain conditional, w > 1 beyond c; 10% empty captions in training, 2 forward passes per step.

  • Wan 的帧数是 4k + 1，潜帧 k + 1；token 数 = 潜帧 × (高/2) × (宽/2)，通道不增加 token。flow matching 里 t = 0 是数据、t = 1 是噪声，Euler 步是 zₜ₋Δ = zₜ − Δ·v̂。

    Wan clips have 4k + 1 frames and k + 1 latent frames; tokens = latent frames × (H/2) × (W/2), and channels add no tokens. In flow matching t = 0 is data and t = 1 noise; the Euler step is zₜ₋Δ = zₜ − Δ·v̂.

  • DiT 不用因果掩码（目标是噪声，不会泄露）；Wan-VAE 是因果的（为了图像/视频共用和流式处理）。

    The DiT uses no causal mask (the target is noise, nothing leaks); the Wan-VAE is causal (to share images/videos and to stream).

CS5242 / CLOSED-BOOK EXAM CHECKLIST

闭卷考前必背清单

Closed-Book Exam Checklist

本页目录

怎么用这份笔记复习：① 先把每讲的「这一讲在干什么」和「易错点」读一遍，建立全局印象；② 把每讲的手算例题和 Quiz 遮住答案自己重算一遍，算不出来再看步骤；③ 最后背下面的清单和「公式与结论速查」。闭卷没有公式可查，下面这些要能默写。

How to revise with these notes: (1) read each lecture's "what this lecture is about" and "common mistakes" first, to get the big picture; (2) cover the answers to each lecture's worked examples and quizzes and redo them yourself, looking at the steps only if stuck; (3) finally memorise the checklist below and the formula sheet. Nothing can be looked up in a closed-book exam, so you must be able to write all of this from memory.

必须会写的推导和证明Derivations and proofs you must be able to write

  • 有限函数类 PAC：Hoeffding + 并集界 + 三段拆分，得 n = (2/ε²)log(2∣F∣/δ)（L2）。

    PAC for a finite function class: Hoeffding + union bound + three-part split, giving n = (2/ε²)log(2∣F∣/δ) (L2).

  • VC 维：阈值 1、区间 2、矩形 4、二维线性 3，都要写「能打散 k 个」和「不能打散 k + 1 个」（L2）。

    VC dimension: thresholds 1, intervals 2, rectangles 4, 2-D linear 3; each needs both "can shatter k points" and "cannot shatter k + 1" (L2).

  • 负梯度是下降最快方向：Taylor + Cauchy–Schwarz（L3）。

    The negative gradient is the steepest descent direction: Taylor + Cauchy–Schwarz (L3).

  • sigmoid、softmax、SiLU 的导数（作业 1）。

    Derivatives of sigmoid, softmax and SiLU (Assignment 1).

  • BCE 和 softmax 交叉熵对 logit 的梯度都是 p − y（L5）。

    The gradients of BCE and softmax cross-entropy with respect to the logits are both p − y (L5).

  • XOR 不是线性可分（四个不等式矛盾），两层可以做到（L6）。

    XOR is not linearly separable (the four inequalities contradict each other), but two layers can do it (L6).

  • Score-function 恒等式、baseline 不改变梯度、均值使平方误差最小（作业 1）。

    The score-function identity, a baseline not changing the gradient, and the mean minimising squared error (Assignment 1).

  • 一层 Transformer = 12d²；临界长度 n∗ = 6d（L7）。

    One Transformer layer = 12d²; critical length n∗ = 6d (L7).

必须会答的简答题（一句话答案）Short-answer questions (one-sentence answers)

  • 传统 ML vs DL？——人工特征 vs 端到端学特征。

    Traditional ML vs DL? — Hand-crafted features vs features learned end to end.

  • 过拟合和欠拟合怎么办？——先加大模型压偏差，再正则化压方差。

    What to do about over- and underfitting? — First enlarge the model to cut bias, then regularise to cut variance.

  • 分类为什么不用 L2 损失？——sigmoid 两端梯度消失，交叉熵把 p(1 − p) 约掉。

    Why not L2 loss for classification? — Sigmoid gradients vanish at both ends; cross-entropy cancels the p(1 − p).

  • 为什么要非线性激活？——线性叠线性还是线性，做不了 XOR。

    Why non-linear activations? — Linear on linear is still linear and cannot do XOR.

  • 为什么随机初始化？——打破对称，否则同层神经元永远一样。

    Why random initialisation? — To break symmetry; otherwise neurons in a layer stay identical forever.

  • SGD 比 GD 好在哪？——便宜，而且噪声帮它离开局部最小和鞍点。

    Why SGD over GD? — It is cheap, and its noise helps it leave local minima and saddle points.

  • 动量 / RMSprop / Adam 各解决什么？——振荡 / 各方向尺度不同 / 两者都解决。

    What do momentum / RMSprop / Adam fix? — Oscillation / different scales across directions / both.

  • 为什么除以 √d_k？——让分数方差为 1，softmax 不过尖。

    Why divide by √d_k? — It keeps the score variance at 1 so the softmax is not too peaked.

  • Transformer 为什么比 RNN 好？——并行、路径短。

    Why are Transformers better than RNNs? — Parallelism and short paths.

  • MoE 为什么替换 FFN？——FFN 占每层参数的 2/3。

    Why does MoE replace the FFN? — The FFN holds 2/3 of each layer's parameters.

  • BERT 为什么用 80/10/10？——微调时没有 [MASK]，要让每个 token 都学好表示。

    Why does BERT use 80/10/10? — There is no [MASK] in fine-tuning, so every token must learn a good representation.

  • 为什么要 warm-up？——Adam 早期估计不稳、第一步每个坐标都移动 η、Post-LN 早期梯度大。

    Why warm-up? — Adam's early estimates are unstable, its first step moves every coordinate by η, and Post-LN has large early gradients.

  • GPT-1/2/3 变了什么？——架构和损失几乎不变，变的是数据、规模和用法。

    What changed across GPT-1/2/3? — Architecture and loss barely changed; data, scale and usage did.

  • prefill vs decode？——并行处理整个提示 vs 一次一个词。

    Prefill vs decode? — Processing the whole prompt in parallel vs one word at a time.

  • 为什么不缓存 Q？——Q 只在当前步用一次。

    Why not cache Q? — Q is used only once, at the current step.

常用数值（闭卷手算要用）Handy numbers for hand calculation

  • e ≈ 2.718，e² ≈ 7.389，e⁴ ≈ 54.60，e⁻¹ ≈ 0.368。

  • ln 2 ≈ 0.693，ln 3 ≈ 1.099，ln 4 ≈ 1.386，ln 8 ≈ 2.079，ln 10 ≈ 2.303。

  • σ(0) = 0.5，σ(1) ≈ 0.731，σ(2) ≈ 0.881，σ′(0) = 0.25。

  • 2¹⁰ = 1024，2²⁰ = 1,048,576，2³⁰ = 1,073,741,824（1 GiB）。

  • 一天 86,400 秒，一年约 3.15 × 10⁷ 秒，1 PF-day = 8.64 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs。

    A day is 86,400 s, a year about 3.15 × 10⁷ s, and 1 PF-day = 8.64 × 10¹⁹ FLOPs.

  • fp32 = 4 字节，fp16/bf16 = 2 字节，fp64 = 8 字节。

    fp32 = 4 bytes, fp16/bf16 = 2 bytes, fp64 = 8 bytes.

CS5242 / FORMULA AND KEY-RESULT SHEET

公式与结论速查

Formula and Key-Result Sheet

考前一页纸：左边是概念，右边是必须能默写的公式或结论。各公式的 TeX 版已在对应讲次里。

One page before the exam: concepts on the left, the formula or result you must be able to write from memory on the right. The TeX version of each formula is in the corresponding lecture.

概念Concept 必须记住的What to remember 讲Lecture
测试误差分解Test-error decomposition 测试误差 = 训练误差 + 泛化误差test error = training error + generalisation error L2
有限函数类 PACPAC for a finite class 要 n ≈ (2/ε²)·log(2∣F∣/δ) 个样本；类越大要的数据越多needs n ≈ (2/ε²)·log(2∣F∣/δ) samples; a bigger class needs more data L2
VC 维VC dimension 能打散的最大点数；d 维线性分类器（带偏置）为 d + 1，二维轴对齐矩形为 4the largest number of points that can be shattered; d + 1 for a d-dimensional linear classifier with bias, 4 for 2-D axis-aligned rectangles L2
梯度下降Gradient descent x ← x − η∇f(x)；负梯度 = 局部下降最快方向x ← x − η∇f(x); the negative gradient is the locally steepest descent L3
学习率与收敛（f = ½θ²）Learning rate and convergence (f = ½θ²) θ ← (1−α)θ；α = 1 一步到位，0 < α < 2 收敛，α = 2 振荡，α > 2 发散θ ← (1−α)θ; α = 1 converges in one step, 0 < α < 2 converges, α = 2 oscillates, α > 2 diverges L3
GD / SGD / mini-batch 用全部 / 1 个 / b 个样本的平均梯度average gradient over all / 1 / b samples L3, L6
线性回归梯度Linear-regression gradient 单样本 (wᵀx − y)x；批量 (1/m)Xᵀ(Xw − y)；解析解 (XᵀX)⁻¹Xᵀyone sample (wᵀx − y)x; batch (1/m)Xᵀ(Xw − y); closed form (XᵀX)⁻¹Xᵀy L4
链式法则Chain rule (g(h(x)))' = g'(h(x))·h'(x)；反向传播 = 从输出往回反复用它backprop = applying it repeatedly from the output backwards L4, L5
数参数Counting parameters 每层权重 = 输入数 × 输出数，偏置 = 输出数；3-4-2 网络共 20 + 6 = 26per layer weights = inputs × outputs, biases = outputs; a 3-4-2 network has 20 + 6 = 26 L5
Sigmoid σ(z) = 1/(1+e⁻ᶻ)，σ' = σ(1−σ)；两端梯度消失gradients vanish at both ends L5, L6
二元交叉熵Binary cross-entropy −[y log p + (1−y) log(1−p)]；对 z 的梯度 p − y；= 最小化负对数似然gradient w.r.t. z is p − y; = minimising negative log-likelihood L5
Softmax + 交叉熵Softmax + cross-entropy pᵢ = e^zᵢ/Σe^zₖ；损失 −Σyᵢ log pᵢ；梯度 pᵢ − yᵢ；∂pᵢ/∂zⱼ = pᵢ(δᵢⱼ − pⱼ)loss −Σyᵢ log pᵢ; gradient pᵢ − yᵢ L5
多标签 vs 多类单标签Multi-label vs single-label 多标签：每类一个 sigmoid；单标签：一个 softmaxmulti-label: one sigmoid per class; single-label: one softmax L5
偏差与方差Bias and variance 欠拟合 = 高偏差，过拟合 = 高方差；先用大模型压偏差，再正则化压方差underfitting = high bias, overfitting = high variance; a bigger model first for bias, then regularisation for variance L5, L6
数据划分Data splits 训练学参数、验证调超参、测试只报告；标准化统计量只用训练集train learns parameters, validation tunes hyperparameters, test only reports; normalisation statistics from the training set only L5
显存（普通 GD，fp32）Memory (plain GD, fp32) 参数 + 梯度 + 激活 + 输入；300B 参数、每步 1 样本 ≈ 3601 GBparameters + gradients + activations + inputs; 300B parameters, 1 sample per step ≈ 3601 GB L5
显存（Adam，fp32）Memory (Adam, fp32) 参数 + 梯度 + 一阶矩 + 二阶矩 = 4 倍参数；300B ≈ 4800 GBparameters + gradients + first + second moments = 4× parameters; 300B ≈ 4800 GB L6
为什么要非线性激活Why non-linear activations 线性层叠加仍是线性；XOR 不是线性可分stacked linear layers are still linear; XOR is not linearly separable L6
ReLU / SiLU max(0, z)，负半轴梯度 0（dying ReLU）；SiLU = zσ(z)，导数 σ(z)[1 + z(1−σ(z))]max(0, z), zero gradient for z < 0 (dying ReLU); SiLU = zσ(z), derivative σ(z)[1 + z(1−σ(z))] L6, A1
动量Momentum v ← βv + g，w ← w − αv；振荡抵消、同向加速oscillations cancel, consistent directions accelerate L6
RMSprop s ← βs + (1−β)g²，w ← w − αg/(√s + ε)；平衡各方向步长equalises step sizes across directions L6
Adam 一阶矩 β₁ = 0.9，二阶矩 β₂ = 0.999，偏差修正除以 (1 − βᵗ)first moment β₁ = 0.9, second moment β₂ = 0.999, bias correction divides by (1 − βᵗ) L6
初始化Initialisation 不能全相同（对称）；Xavier 标准差 √(2/(fan_in+fan_out))，He 标准差 √(2/fan_in)not all equal (symmetry); Xavier std √(2/(fan_in+fan_out)), He std √(2/fan_in) L6
权重衰减Weight decay J + (α/2)‖W‖²，梯度加 αw；AdamW 把衰减和 Adam 更新分开the gradient gains αw; AdamW separates decay from the Adam update L6
其他正则化Other regularisation 早停、数据增强、注入噪声early stopping, data augmentation, noise injection L6
Score function ∇E[g] = E[g·∇log p]；减常数 baseline 不改变梯度subtracting a constant baseline does not change the gradient A1
均值性质Property of the mean E‖X − a‖² = E‖X − μ‖² + ‖a − μ‖²，最小值在 a = μminimised at a = μ A1
缩放点积注意力Scaled dot-product attention softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k + M)V；掩码 M 在 softmax 之前把未来位置设为 −∞；除以 √d_k 使分数方差为 1the mask M sets future positions to −∞ before the softmax; dividing by √d_k gives scores variance 1 L7
一层 Transformer 的参数Parameters of one Transformer layer 注意力 4d² + FFN 8d² = 12d²（带偏置和两个 LN 是 12d² + 13d）；多头不增加参数attention 4d² + FFN 8d² = 12d² (12d² + 13d with biases and two LNs); multiple heads add no parameters L7, L9
整个 GPT 的参数Parameters of a whole GPT N = Vd + n_ctx·d + L(12d² + 13d) + 2d；嵌入绑定只算一次；大模型 N ≈ 12Ld²tied embeddings count once; for large models N ≈ 12Ld² L9
算力Compute 前向 2N/token，训练 6N/token，总计 6ND；注意力分数另加 4nd/token/层，临界长度 n∗ = 6d；1 PF-day = 8.64×10¹⁹ FLOPs；MFU = 所需 FLOPs ÷ (时间 × GPU 数 × 峰值)forward 2N per token, training 6N per token, 6ND in total; attention scores add 4nd per token per layer, critical length n∗ = 6d; MFU = FLOPs needed ÷ (time × GPUs × peak) L7, L9
MoE y = Σ gᵢEᵢ；∂y/∂zⱼ = gⱼ(Eⱼ − y)；Noisy top-k；Importance 和 Load 两个均衡损失，CV² = 方差/均值²two balancing losses, Importance and Load, with CV² = variance/mean² L7
位置编码Positional encoding 正余弦 PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos/10000^(2i/d))，没有参数；BERT/GPT 用学出来的表，有 n_ctx·d 个参数sinusoidal, no parameters; BERT/GPT use a learned table with n_ctx·d parameters L7, L8
BERT 预训练BERT pre-training 选 15%：80% [MASK]、10% 随机词、10% 不变，都预测原词，只对选中位置平均；L = L_MLM + L_NSPchoose 15%: 80% [MASK], 10% random word, 10% unchanged, all predict the original word, averaged over selected positions only L8
BERT 微调BERT fine-tuning 分类：[CLS] 接 H×K；QA：S、E 两个向量，损失 −ln p_start − ln p_end，解码要求 i ≤ j；NER：每个 token 接 H×Kclassification: H×K on [CLS]; QA: vectors S and E, loss −ln p_start − ln p_end, decoding requires i ≤ j; NER: H×K on every token L8
warm-up 先线性升到峰值再衰减；原因是 Adam 早期的均值/方差估计不稳，且 Post-LN 早期梯度大；Adam 第一步每个坐标移动 ηrise linearly to the peak, then decay; because Adam's early mean/variance estimates are unstable and Post-LN has large early gradients; Adam's first step moves every coordinate by η L8, L9
困惑度Perplexity PPL = e^(平均损失)；bit = nat/ln 2；初始损失 ≈ ln V；不同分词器用 bits/byte 比较PPL = e^(average loss); bit = nat/ln 2; initial loss ≈ ln V; compare tokenisers with bits/byte L9
推理前向次数与 KV 缓存Forward passes and KV cache 每轮 = 输出词数 + 1；prefill 并行、decode 串行；prefill 只算 1 次 softmax；缓存 K、V，不缓存 Q；BERT 一次前向per turn = output words + 1; prefill parallel, decode sequential; prefill does one softmax; cache K and V, not Q; BERT takes one forward pass L9, L10
解码规则Decoding rules 贪心 = top-1；top-k 截断后重新归一化；beam search 分数 ln P(Y)/((5 + ∣Y∣)/6)^α，α = 0.6；多选题用平均每 token log 概率greedy = top-1; top-k renormalises after truncation; beam score ln P(Y)/((5 + ∣Y∣)/6)^α with α = 0.6; multiple choice uses average per-token log-probability L9, L10
三代 GPTThree GPT generations 117M / 1.5B / 175B；微调 / 零样本 / 少样本；Post-LN → Pre-LN；GPT-3 用 Adam(0.9, 0.95)、裁剪 1.0、lr 0.6×10⁻⁴、batch 3.2M tokenfine-tuning / zero-shot / few-shot; GPT-3 uses Adam(0.9, 0.95), clipping 1.0, lr 0.6×10⁻⁴, batch 3.2M tokens L9
三步 RLHFThree-step RLHF SFT（人写示范，监督学习）→ RM（人排序，C(K,2) 对，−ln σ(r_w − r_l)）→ PPO（RM 分数 − β·KL + γ·预训练项）；后训练算力 < 预训练 2%SFT (human demos) → RM (human rankings) → PPO (RM score − β·KL + γ·pre-training term); post-training compute < 2% of pre-training L11
PPO 细节PPO details 四个网络：演员、参考 SFT（冻结）、RM（冻结）、价值网络（一起训练）；裁剪 ε = 0.2；优势 = 分数 − V；ptx 项减少对齐税four networks: actor, reference SFT (frozen), RM (frozen), value network (trained); clipping ε = 0.2; advantage = score − V; the ptx term reduces the alignment tax L11
扩散前向过程Diffusion forward process xₜ = √(1 − βₜ)xₜ₋₁ + √βₜ εₜ；ᾱₜ = ∏(1 − βₛ)；xₜ = √ᾱₜ x₀ + √(1 − ᾱₜ)ε；无可学参数no learnable parameters L12
扩散训练与生成Diffusion training and generation 损失 ∥ε − ε_θ(xₜ, t)∥²，每个样本一个随机 t；生成 t = T → 1 依次走，DDPM 1000 步、DDIM 20–50 步loss with one random t per sample; generation walks t = T → 1, DDPM 1000 steps, DDIM 20–50 L12
潜扩散与条件Latent diffusion and conditioning SD：512²×3 → 64×64×4（48 倍），VAE 冻结；CLIP 77×768 作交叉注意力 K、V；CFG ε̂ = u + w(c − u)，w ≈ 7.5，训练时 10% 空标题SD: 48× compression, frozen VAE; CLIP 77×768 as K, V; CFG with w ≈ 7.5 and 10% empty captions L12

CS5242 / SELF-TEST QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS

自测题与答案

Self-Test Questions and Answers

13 道小题，前面偏计算、后面偏概念。先自己做，再看答案。

13 short questions: calculations first, concepts later. Try them yourself before reading the answers.

  1. [L3 梯度下降] f(θ) = ½θ²，θ⁽⁰⁾ = 8，学习率 α = 0.5。走 3 步后 θ = ? 若 α = 2.5 会怎样？

    [L3 gradient descent] f(θ) = ½θ², θ⁽⁰⁾ = 8, learning rate α = 0.5. What is θ after 3 steps? What happens with α = 2.5?

    看答案 · Answer

    θ ← (1 − 0.5)θ，三步后 8 × 0.5³ = 1。α = 2.5 时 ∣1 − α∣ = 1.5 > 1，符号交替且越来越大，发散。

    θ ← (1 − 0.5)θ, so after three steps 8 × 0.5³ = 1. With α = 2.5, ∣1 − α∣ = 1.5 > 1: the sign alternates and the size grows, so it diverges.

  2. [L4 线性回归] w = (1, 2)，样本 x = (1, 1)，y = 2，损失 ½(wᵀx − y)²，α = 0.1。求预测、梯度和更新后的 w。

    [L4 linear regression] w = (1, 2), sample x = (1, 1), y = 2, loss ½(wᵀx − y)², α = 0.1. Find the prediction, the gradient and the updated w.

    看答案 · Answer

    预测 1 + 2 = 3，误差 3 − 2 = 1，梯度 = 1 × (1, 1) = (1, 1)，更新后 w = (1, 2) − 0.1 × (1, 1) = (0.9, 1.9)。

    Prediction 1 + 2 = 3, error 3 − 2 = 1, gradient 1 × (1, 1) = (1, 1), updated w = (1, 2) − 0.1 × (1, 1) = (0.9, 1.9).

  3. [L5 数参数] 10 个输入 → 5 个隐藏单元 → 3 个输出的 MLP，共有多少个可学参数？

    [L5 counting parameters] How many learnable parameters does an MLP with 10 inputs → 5 hidden units → 3 outputs have?

    看答案 · Answer

    权重 10×5 + 5×3 = 65，偏置 5 + 3 = 8，共 73 个。

    Weights 10×5 + 5×3 = 65, biases 5 + 3 = 8, 73 in total.

  4. [L5 Sigmoid] σ(0) 和 σ'(0) 各是多少？为什么说 z = 10 时会梯度消失？

    [L5 sigmoid] What are σ(0) and σ'(0)? Why does the gradient vanish at z = 10?

    看答案 · Answer

    σ(0) = 0.5，σ'(0) = 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25（这是 sigmoid 导数的最大值）。z = 10 时 σ ≈ 0.99995，σ' ≈ 4.5 × 10⁻⁵，反向传播时乘上它梯度几乎为 0。

    σ(0) = 0.5, σ'(0) = 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25 (the largest value of the sigmoid's derivative). At z = 10, σ ≈ 0.99995 and σ' ≈ 4.5 × 10⁻⁵, so multiplying by it in backprop leaves almost no gradient.

  5. [L5 二元交叉熵] 真实标签 y = 1，模型输出 p = 0.8。损失是多少？对 logit z 的梯度是多少？

    [L5 binary cross-entropy] True label y = 1, model output p = 0.8. What is the loss, and the gradient with respect to the logit z?

    看答案 · Answer

    损失 −ln 0.8 ≈ 0.223；梯度 p − y = 0.8 − 1 = −0.2（负号表示应增大 z）。

    Loss −ln 0.8 ≈ 0.223; gradient p − y = 0.8 − 1 = −0.2 (the minus sign means z should increase).

  6. [L5 Softmax] logit z = (0, ln 3)，真实类别是第 2 类。求概率 p、交叉熵损失和对 z 的梯度。

    [L5 softmax] Logits z = (0, ln 3), true class 2. Find p, the cross-entropy loss and the gradient with respect to z.

    看答案 · Answer

    e⁰ = 1，e^(ln 3) = 3，p = (1/4, 3/4)。损失 −ln(3/4) ≈ 0.288。梯度 p − y = (0.25, −0.25)。

    e⁰ = 1, e^(ln 3) = 3, p = (1/4, 3/4). Loss −ln(3/4) ≈ 0.288. Gradient p − y = (0.25, −0.25).

  7. [L5 调参] 多项式次数 1 / 2 / 9 的训练误差为 1.2 / 0.5 / 0.1，验证误差为 1.3 / 0.3 / 0.4。选哪个？哪个过拟合、哪个欠拟合？

    [L5 model selection] Degrees 1 / 2 / 9 have training errors 1.2 / 0.5 / 0.1 and validation errors 1.3 / 0.3 / 0.4. Which do you choose? Which overfits and which underfits?

    看答案 · Answer

    选次数 2（验证误差最小）。次数 9 训练误差最小但验证误差变大，是过拟合；次数 1 两个误差都大，是欠拟合。

    Choose degree 2 (lowest validation error). Degree 9 has the lowest training error but a higher validation error — overfitting; degree 1 has both errors high — underfitting.

  8. [L5 分类损失] 用 sigmoid 输出做分类时，为什么不用 L2 损失而用交叉熵？

    [L5 classification loss] With a sigmoid output, why use cross-entropy rather than L2 loss?

    看答案 · Answer

    L2 损失的梯度里带一个 σ'(z)，z 很大或很小时它≈ 0，就算预测错得很离谱也学不动（梯度消失）。交叉熵对 z 的梯度恰好是 p − y，错得越多梯度越大；它还等价于最大化对数似然。

    The L2 gradient contains a factor σ'(z), which is ≈ 0 when z is very large or very small, so even a badly wrong prediction cannot learn (vanishing gradient). Cross-entropy's gradient with respect to z is exactly p − y, larger the more wrong it is; it is also equivalent to maximising the log-likelihood.

  9. [L6 非线性] 为什么没有隐藏层（或只用线性激活）的网络学不会 XOR？

    [L6 non-linearity] Why can a network with no hidden layer (or only linear activations) not learn XOR?

    看答案 · Answer

    线性层叠加仍是线性函数，只能画一条直线做分界；XOR 的 (0,1)(1,0) 和 (0,0)(1,1) 在对角上，任何一条直线都分不开。需要带非线性激活的隐藏层。

    Stacked linear layers are still a linear function and can only draw one straight boundary; XOR's (0,1), (1,0) and (0,0), (1,1) sit on opposite diagonals, and no straight line separates them. A hidden layer with a non-linear activation is needed.

  10. [L6 Adam] β₁ = 0.9，m₀ = 0，第一步梯度 g₁ = 0.5。m₁ 和修正后的 m̂₁ 各是多少？为什么要修正？

    [L6 Adam] β₁ = 0.9, m₀ = 0, first gradient g₁ = 0.5. What are m₁ and the corrected m̂₁? Why correct at all?

    看答案 · Answer

    m₁ = 0.9 × 0 + 0.1 × 0.5 = 0.05；m̂₁ = 0.05/(1 − 0.9) = 0.5。因为 m 从 0 开始，初期历史不足会严重偏小；修正后第一步恰好等于当前梯度，t 大时修正自动变成 1。

    m₁ = 0.9 × 0 + 0.1 × 0.5 = 0.05; m̂₁ = 0.05/(1 − 0.9) = 0.5. Because m starts at 0, it is badly biased low while history is short; after correction the first step equals the current gradient, and for large t the correction factor becomes 1.

  11. [L6 显存] 一个 7B（70 亿）参数的模型用 Adam、fp32 训练，忽略激活和输入，至少要多少显存？

    [L6 memory] How much memory, at least, does training a 7B-parameter model with Adam in fp32 need, ignoring activations and inputs?

    看答案 · Answer

    每个参数 4 字节，7B × 4 = 28 GB；参数、梯度、一阶矩、二阶矩各一份，共 4 × 28 = 112 GB。

    4 bytes per parameter, 7B × 4 = 28 GB; one copy each of parameters, gradients, first and second moments: 4 × 28 = 112 GB.

  12. [L6 初始化] 把所有权重都初始化成 0，会发生什么？

    [L6 initialisation] What happens if every weight is initialised to 0?

    看答案 · Answer

    同一层所有神经元输出一样、梯度一样、更新也一样，永远保持相同（对称性无法打破），整层等于一个神经元；全 0 时有些层的梯度甚至全为 0。所以要随机初始化。

    Every neuron in a layer has the same output, gradient and update, so they stay identical forever (symmetry is never broken) and the layer acts as one neuron; with all zeros some layers' gradients are even entirely 0. Hence random initialisation.

  13. [L2 VC 维] 二维平面上带偏置的线性分类器 VC 维是多少？为什么 4 个点打散不了？

    [L2 VC dimension] What is the VC dimension of a linear classifier with bias in the plane? Why can 4 points not be shattered?

    看答案 · Answer

    VC 维 = 3（= d + 1）。三个不共线的点 8 种标注都能实现；4 个点时，若没有点在另三点的三角形内，把对角两点标 + 、另一对对角标 −，两条连线相交，交点必须同时为 + 和 −，矛盾；若有点在三角形内，把它标 + 、三个顶点标 − 也做不到。

    VC dimension = 3 (= d + 1). Three non-collinear points can realise all 8 labellings. With 4 points: if none lies inside the triangle of the other three, label one diagonal pair + and the other −; the two diagonals cross, and the crossing point would have to be both + and −, a contradiction. If one point lies inside the triangle, labelling it + and the three corners − is also impossible.

后半程自测题（L7–L12）Second-Half Self-Test (L7–L12)

  1. [L7] 单头注意力，d_k = 4，某位置对 3 个 token 的 q·k = (2, 0, 2)，不加掩码，求注意力权重。如果这是因果解码器的第 2 个位置呢？

    [L7] Single-head attention, d_k = 4; one position's q·k with 3 tokens is (2, 0, 2). Without a mask, find the attention weights. What if this is position 2 of a causal decoder?

    看答案 · Answer

    缩放后 (1, 0, 1)，softmax = (e, 1, e)/(2e + 1) ≈ (0.422, 0.155, 0.422)。因果第 2 位：(1, 0, −∞) → (e, 1, 0)/(e + 1) ≈ (0.731, 0.269, 0)。

    Scaled: (1, 0, 1); softmax = (e, 1, e)/(2e + 1) ≈ (0.422, 0.155, 0.422). Causal position 2: (1, 0, −∞) → (e, 1, 0)/(e + 1) ≈ (0.731, 0.269, 0).

  2. [L7] 仅解码器模型：d = 768、12 层、V = 50,000、嵌入绑定、正余弦位置编码、忽略偏置和 LN，求参数总数。

    [L7] Decoder-only model: d = 768, 12 layers, V = 50,000, tied embeddings, sinusoidal positions, ignoring biases and LN. Find the total parameter count.

    看答案 · Answer

    每层 12 × 768² = 7,077,888，12 层 84,934,656；嵌入 50,000 × 768 = 38,400,000；合计 123,334,656 ≈ 123M。

    Per layer 12 × 768² = 7,077,888, 12 layers 84,934,656; embeddings 50,000 × 768 = 38,400,000; total 123,334,656 ≈ 123M.

  3. [L7] 两个专家输出 E = (4, 0)，门控 g = softmax(z) = (1/2, 1/2)，求 y 和 ∂y/∂z。

    [L7] Two experts output E = (4, 0) and the gate is g = softmax(z) = (1/2, 1/2). Find y and ∂y/∂z.

    看答案 · Answer

    y = (4 + 0)/2 = 2；∂y/∂z₁ = g₁(E₁ − y) = 0.5 × 2 = 1，∂y/∂z₂ = 0.5 × (0 − 2) = −1。

    y = (4 + 0)/2 = 2; ∂y/∂z₁ = g₁(E₁ − y) = 0.5 × 2 = 1, ∂y/∂z₂ = 0.5 × (0 − 2) = −1.

  4. [L8] 选中 2 个位置：一个换成 [MASK]，真词概率 0.5；一个换成随机词 dog，真词 cat 的概率 0.25、dog 的概率 0.6。B 是真下一句，P(IsNext) = 0.9。求总损失。

    [L8] Two positions are selected: one becomes [MASK] with true-word probability 0.5; the other becomes the random word dog, with P(cat, the true word) = 0.25 and P(dog) = 0.6. B is the true next sentence, P(IsNext) = 0.9. Find the total loss.

    看答案 · Answer

    MLM = (ln 2 + ln 4)/2 = 1.5 ln 2 ≈ 1.040（第二个位置目标是 cat，不是 dog）；NSP = −ln 0.9 ≈ 0.105；总损失 ≈ 1.145。

    MLM = (ln 2 + ln 4)/2 = 1.5 ln 2 ≈ 1.040 (the second position's target is cat, not dog); NSP = −ln 0.9 ≈ 0.105; total loss ≈ 1.145.

  5. [L9] N = 10⁹ 的模型训练 2 × 10¹¹ 个 token，要多少 FLOPs？合多少 PF-day？

    [L9] Training a model with N = 10⁹ on 2 × 10¹¹ tokens: how many FLOPs, and how many PF-days?

    看答案 · Answer

    6ND = 6 × 10⁹ × 2 × 10¹¹ = 1.2 × 10²¹ FLOPs；÷ 8.64 × 10¹⁹ ≈ 13.9 PF-day。

    6ND = 6 × 10⁹ × 2 × 10¹¹ = 1.2 × 10²¹ FLOPs; ÷ 8.64 × 10¹⁹ ≈ 13.9 PF-days.

  6. [L9] 3 个位置正确词概率 1/2、1/2、1/8，求平均损失和困惑度。

    [L9] Correct-word probabilities at 3 positions are 1/2, 1/2, 1/8. Find the average loss and the perplexity.

    看答案 · Answer

    总损失 ln 2 + ln 2 + 3 ln 2 = 5 ln 2，平均 (5/3) ln 2 ≈ 1.155；PPL = 2^(5/3) ≈ 3.17。

    Total loss ln 2 + ln 2 + 3 ln 2 = 5 ln 2, average (5/3) ln 2 ≈ 1.155; PPL = 2^(5/3) ≈ 3.17.

  7. [L10] 输入 50 个 token、输出 20 个 token（不含 EOS），前向几次？第二轮再输入 10 个、输出 5 个，两轮共几次？

    [L10] 50 input tokens and 20 output tokens (excluding EOS): how many forward passes? A second turn with 10 inputs and 5 outputs: how many for both turns?

    看答案 · Answer

    第一轮 20 + 1 = 21 次；第二轮 5 + 1 = 6 次；共 27 次。输入长度不影响次数，只占一次 prefill。

    Turn 1: 20 + 1 = 21; turn 2: 5 + 1 = 6; 27 in total. Input length does not change the count; it takes just one prefill.

  8. [L10] 概率 (0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1)，做 top-2，分布是多少？按概率从大到小排区间，u = 0.6 抽到哪个？

    [L10] Probabilities (0.4, 0.3, 0.2, 0.1) with top-2: what is the distribution? With intervals ordered from most to least likely, which token does u = 0.6 pick?

    看答案 · Answer

    保留 0.4、0.3，和 0.7 → (0.571, 0.429, 0, 0)。区间 [0, 0.571) 和 [0.571, 1)，u = 0.6 → 第二个 token。

    Keep 0.4 and 0.3, sum 0.7 → (0.571, 0.429, 0, 0). Intervals [0, 0.571) and [0.571, 1); u = 0.6 → the second token.

  9. [L10] 两个完整答案：S 长 2（含 EOS）、P = 0.3；L 长 5、P = 0.2。α = 0.6 时 beam search 选哪个？

    [L10] Two finished answers: S of length 2 (including EOS) with P = 0.3; L of length 5 with P = 0.2. Which does beam search choose with α = 0.6?

    看答案 · Answer

    lp(2) = (7/6)^0.6 ≈ 1.097，S 分数 = ln 0.3/1.097 ≈ −1.098；lp(5) = (10/6)^0.6 ≈ 1.359，L 分数 = ln 0.2/1.359 ≈ −1.185。S 分数更高，选 S。

    lp(2) = (7/6)^0.6 ≈ 1.097, S scores ln 0.3/1.097 ≈ −1.098; lp(5) = (10/6)^0.6 ≈ 1.359, L scores ln 0.2/1.359 ≈ −1.185. S scores higher, so S is chosen.

  10. [L11] 一个提示有 K = 9 个回答被人排好序，能组成多少对比较？若某一对 r_w − r_l = ln 3，这一对的损失是多少？

    [L11] One prompt has K = 9 ranked answers. How many comparison pairs? If one pair has r_w − r_l = ln 3, what is its loss?

    看答案 · Answer

    C(9, 2) = 36 对。σ(ln 3) = 3/4，损失 −ln(3/4) = ln(4/3) ≈ 0.288。

    C(9, 2) = 36 pairs. σ(ln 3) = 3/4, loss −ln(3/4) = ln(4/3) ≈ 0.288.

  11. [L11] PPO 中某答案 RM 分数 r = 2，β = 0.1，ln(π_RL/π_SFT) 在整个答案上的和是 3，价值网络 V = 1.5，求扣除 KL 后的分数和优势。

    [L11] In PPO an answer has RM score r = 2, β = 0.1, ln(π_RL/π_SFT) summed over the answer is 3, and the value network gives V = 1.5. Find the KL-adjusted score and the advantage.

    看答案 · Answer

    扣除 KL 后 R = 2 − 0.1 × 3 = 1.7；优势 = 1.7 − 1.5 = 0.2 > 0，这个答案被往上推。

    KL-adjusted R = 2 − 0.1 × 3 = 1.7; advantage = 1.7 − 1.5 = 0.2 > 0, so this answer is pushed up.

  12. [L12] ᾱₜ = 0.64，x₀ = (1, 0)，ε = (0.5, −1)，求 xₜ。若网络预测 ε̂ = (0.5, −0.5)，损失是多少？

    [L12] ᾱₜ = 0.64, x₀ = (1, 0), ε = (0.5, −1). Find xₜ. If the network predicts ε̂ = (0.5, −0.5), what is the loss?

    看答案 · Answer

    xₜ = 0.8(1, 0) + 0.6(0.5, −1) = (1.1, −0.6)；损失 0² + 0.5² = 0.25。

    xₜ = 0.8(1, 0) + 0.6(0.5, −1) = (1.1, −0.6); loss 0² + 0.5² = 0.25.

  13. [L12] 无条件预测 u = (0, 1)，有条件预测 c = (1, 1)，w = 3 时 CFG 给出的 ε̂ 是多少？w = 0 和 w = 1 呢？

    [L12] Unconditional prediction u = (0, 1), conditional c = (1, 1). What is the CFG ε̂ for w = 3? For w = 0 and w = 1?

    看答案 · Answer

    c − u = (1, 0)，w = 3：ε̂ = (0, 1) + 3(1, 0) = (3, 1)。w = 0 得 u = (0, 1)（忽略提示），w = 1 得 c = (1, 1)。

    c − u = (1, 0); w = 3: ε̂ = (3, 1). w = 0 gives u = (0, 1) (prompt ignored); w = 1 gives c = (1, 1).

  14. [L12] SD 1.x 的 VAE（f = 8、4 通道）编码 768 × 768 × 3 的图，潜变量形状和压缩倍数是多少？

    [L12] SD 1.x's VAE (f = 8, 4 channels) encodes a 768 × 768 × 3 image. What are the latent shape and the compression factor?

    看答案 · Answer

    96 × 96 × 4 = 36,864 个值；768 × 768 × 3 = 1,769,472，压缩 48 倍（和 512² 时一样）。

    96 × 96 × 4 = 36,864 values; 768 × 768 × 3 = 1,769,472, a 48× compression (same as at 512²).

  15. [L12] Wan（时间 ÷4、空间 ÷8、1 × 2 × 2 patch）处理 17 帧 256 × 256 的视频，有几个潜帧、多少 token？

    [L12] Wan (time ÷4, space ÷8, 1 × 2 × 2 patches) processes a 17-frame 256 × 256 clip. How many latent frames and tokens?

    看答案 · Answer

    潜帧 1 + 16/4 = 5，空间 32 × 32；token = 5 × 16 × 16 = 1,280。

    Latent frames 1 + 16/4 = 5, spatial 32 × 32; tokens = 5 × 16 × 16 = 1,280.

  16. [L12] flow matching：z₀ = 2，ε = 0，t = 0.5，求 zₜ 和 v*。若 v̂ = v*，Δ = 0.5 的 Euler 一步到哪里？

    [L12] Flow matching: z₀ = 2, ε = 0, t = 0.5. Find zₜ and v*. If v̂ = v*, where does one Euler step with Δ = 0.5 land?

    看答案 · Answer

    zₜ = 0.5 × 2 + 0.5 × 0 = 1，v* = 0 − 2 = −2；Euler：1 − 0.5 × (−2) = 2，正好回到 z₀（直线路径一步就准）。

    zₜ = 1, v* = −2; Euler: 1 − 0.5 × (−2) = 2, exactly z₀ (a straight path is exact in one step).

Assignment and Quiz Overview

本页目录

说明：这一页把五份作业、八次 Quiz 和官方 32 道练习题放在一张地图上：每份考什么、在本网站哪一页有完整解析、哪些题型反复出现，以及闭卷时最常用的解题套路。先看这一页定方向，再去对应页面逐题重算。

How to use: this page puts the five assignments, eight quizzes and the 32 official practice questions on one map — what each tests, where the full solution is on this site, which question types recur, and the solving templates you will use most in the closed-book exam. Read this page first for direction, then redo each question on its own page.

1. 期末形式（来自官方练习册说明）Final exam format (from the practice booklet)

  • 闭卷，可带一个获批准的非编程计算器；每题 5 分或 10 分，官方 32 道练习题「格式、风格、难度都和期末同分值的题一样」。

    Closed book with an approved non-programmable calculator; each question is worth 5 or 10 marks, and the 32 official practice questions have "the same format, style and level of difficulty as a question of the final assessment with the same number of marks".

  • 按方法给分：每一步都要写出来；从原始表达式算，中间结果不要四舍五入；除非另有说明，答案保留 3 位有效数字，精确计数、分数、符号表达式可以保留精确形式。

    Marks are given for method, so show every step; compute from the original expressions without rounding intermediate results; unless stated otherwise give three significant figures, while exact counts, fractions and symbolic expressions may stay exact.

  • ln 是自然对数；向量默认是列向量；∥v∥₂² 是各分量平方和。二进制单位 1 KiB = 2¹⁰、1 MiB = 2²⁰、1 GiB = 2³⁰ 字节；十进制单位 1 GB = 10⁹ 字节、1 GFLOP = 10⁹ 次浮点运算。题目写哪个就用哪个。

    ln is the natural log; vectors are column vectors; ∥v∥₂² is the sum of squared components. Binary units 1 KiB = 2¹⁰, 1 MiB = 2²⁰, 1 GiB = 2³⁰ bytes; decimal units 1 GB = 10⁹ bytes, 1 GFLOP = 10⁹ FLOPs. Use whichever the question states.

  • 每道题通常是「(a) 计算 + (b) 计算 + 一句解释」。解释部分常占 0.5–1.5 分，要点是用你算出来的数字说明原因，而不是背定义。

    A question is usually "(a) calculation + (b) calculation + one explanation". The explanation is often worth 0.5–1.5 marks, and the point is to explain using the numbers you just computed, not to recite a definition.

4. 闭卷答题的通用步骤General steps for closed-book answers

  1. 先把题目给的形状写在旁边（谁是行、谁是列）；练习 Q1、Q19 都专门写了行列含义，搞反就全错。

    Write the shapes next to the question first (what rows and columns mean); practice Q1 and Q19 spell this out, and swapping them ruins everything.

  2. 保留精确形式：ln 3、1/3、e^(−1/2) 先不算小数，最后一步再给 3 位有效数字。

    Keep exact forms such as ln 3, 1/3, e^(−1/2) until the last step, then give three significant figures.

  3. 求导题：题目说「不要先把变量换成常数」时，先写出含变量的式子（商的形式），再代值。

    Derivative questions: when told not to replace variables by constants first, write the symbolic expression (a quotient) and only then substitute.

  4. 解释题：一句话「结论 + 你算出的数字 + 机制」。例：「B 的 prior 损失和 A 一样 (0.04)，但输出误差是 A 的两倍 (0.08)，因为第二个分量通过两条路径影响输出」。

    Explanation parts: one sentence of "conclusion + your number + mechanism". E.g. "B has the same prior loss as A (0.04) but twice the output error (0.08), because its second coordinate reaches the output through two paths".

  5. 检查单位和量级：MiB 还是 MB、每头还是所有头、每层还是全模型、每 token 还是整个 batch。

    Check units and scale: MiB or MB, per head or all heads, per layer or whole model, per token or whole batch.

作业与 Quiz 易错点Common mistakes across assignments and quizzes

  • 先 softmax 再掩码是错的：被屏蔽位置要在 softmax 之前设成 −∞，权重才是精确的 0，分母也不含它。

    Masking after the softmax is wrong: masked positions must be −∞ before the softmax, so their weight is exactly 0 and they are not in the denominator.

  • 训练循环忘了 optimizer.zero_grad()：梯度会累加，第 k 步用的是前 k 步梯度之和。

    Forgetting optimizer.zero_grad(): gradients accumulate, so step k uses the sum of the first k gradients.

  • 标准化的均值和标准差在全部数据上算，是数据泄露；验证集、测试集都要用训练集的统计量。

    Computing normalisation statistics on all data is leakage; validation and test sets must use the training statistics.

  • Adam 第一步不做偏差修正，步长是 α·(1 − β₁)/√(1 − β₂) ≈ 3.16α，而不是 α。

    Without bias correction Adam's first step is α·(1 − β₁)/√(1 − β₂) ≈ 3.16α, not α.

  • SFT 掩码忘了右移一位：第一个回答 token 永远学不到，还会把 PAD 当成目标。

    An SFT mask without the one-position shift never trains the first response token and may score PAD as a target.

  • MoE 的 Importance 向量维度是专家数，不是 token 数；CV² 用总体方差（除以 n），不是样本方差。

    The Importance vector has one entry per expert, not per token; CV² uses the population variance (divide by n).

作业 2–5 精讲

Assignments 2–5 in Detail

本页目录

说明：作业 2–5 都是 notebook，闭卷不会让你写代码，但会考代码背后的概念和数：为什么要 zero_grad、闭式解是什么、为什么只能用训练集的统计量、Adam 每个公式的意思、训练损失从 ln V 开始。下面每份作业先列「考什么」，再逐题给出题目、解析和你自己那份作业里的数值结果。

These are notebooks; the closed-book exam will not ask for code, but it will test the concepts and numbers behind it: why zero_grad, what the closed form is, why only training statistics may be used, what each Adam equation means, why training loss starts at ln V. For each assignment: what it tests, then each task with its solution and the numbers from your own submission.

1. 作业 2：PyTorch 与线性回归Assignment 2: PyTorch and linear regression

考什么：autograd 的计算图、手动更新参数为什么要 torch.no_grad()、为什么要清零梯度、nn.Linear 的参数和梯度形状、学习率过小/合适/发散、最小二乘闭式解与伪逆、Ridge 和 Lasso 只惩罚权重不惩罚偏置。

Tested: the autograd graph, why manual updates need torch.no_grad(), why gradients must be zeroed, the shapes of nn.Linear parameters and gradients, learning rates that are too small / right / divergent, the least-squares closed form and pseudoinverse, and that Ridge and Lasso penalise the weight but not the bias.

  • 2.1 手算一步（必会）：x = 1.5，w = −0.5，b = 2，y = 3，ŷ = wx + b = 1.25，L = (ŷ − y)² = 3.0625。∂L/∂ŷ = 2(ŷ − y) = −3.5；∂L/∂w = −3.5 × x = −5.25；∂L/∂b = −3.5；∂L/∂x = −3.5 × w = 1.75（x 也设了 requires_grad，所以也有梯度）。学习率 0.05：w → −0.5 + 0.2625 = −0.2375，b → 2 + 0.175 = 2.175，新预测 1.81875，新损失 ≈ 1.395。

    2.1 one step by hand: ŷ = 1.25, L = 3.0625; ∂L/∂ŷ = −3.5, ∂L/∂w = −5.25, ∂L/∂b = −3.5, ∂L/∂x = 1.75 (x also requires grad). With learning rate 0.05: w → −0.2375, b → 2.175, new prediction 1.81875, new loss ≈ 1.395.

  • 为什么更新要包在 torch.no_grad() 里：更新 w ← w − ηg 本身不是模型的一部分；不关掉追踪，autograd 会把这次减法记进计算图，下一次反向传播会穿过「更新」这一步，而且对叶子张量原地修改会报错。

    Why the update sits inside torch.no_grad(): w ← w − ηg is not part of the model; with tracking on, autograd would record the subtraction in the graph, the next backward pass would run through the update, and in-place changes to a leaf tensor raise an error.

  • 2.2(a) 为什么要 zero_grad()：PyTorch 默认累加梯度：每次 backward() 把新梯度加到 .grad 上而不是覆盖（这样设计是为了梯度累积、共享参数）。如果每步都不清零，第 k 步用的是前 k 步梯度之和，有效步长越来越大，参数冲过最优点、损失振荡甚至发散。

    2.2(a) why zero_grad(): PyTorch accumulates gradients by default — each backward() adds into .grad instead of overwriting (by design, for gradient accumulation and shared parameters). Without zeroing, step k uses the sum of the first k gradients, the effective step keeps growing, and the parameters overshoot, oscillate or diverge.

  • 2.2(b) grad_fn：grad_fn=<PowBackward0> 表示这个张量是某个被追踪的运算（这里是平方）的输出，反向传播时会调用它的局部求导函数；直接创建的叶子参数 w、b 不是任何运算的结果，所以 grad_fn=None，梯度直接累加到它们的 .grad 里。20 步 SGD 后 w ≈ 0.307、b ≈ 2.538，预测 ≈ 2.9993，损失 ≈ 4.6 × 10⁻⁷。

    2.2(b) grad_fn: grad_fn=<PowBackward0> marks a tensor produced by a tracked operation (here a square), whose local backward is called during backprop; leaf parameters w, b are not produced by any operation, so grad_fn=None and gradients accumulate directly into .grad. After 20 SGD steps w ≈ 0.307, b ≈ 2.538, prediction ≈ 2.9993, loss ≈ 4.6 × 10⁻⁷.

  • 2.4 nn.Linear(3, 2) 的形状：输入 (10, 3)，计算 ŷ = xWᵀ + b，输出 (10, 2)。PyTorch 把权重存成 (out, in) = (2, 3)，偏置 (2,)；标量损失对任何参数的梯度和这个参数同形状，所以 dL/dW 是 (2, 3)、dL/db 是 (2,)。

    2.4 shapes of nn.Linear(3, 2): input (10, 3), ŷ = xWᵀ + b, output (10, 2). PyTorch stores the weight as (out, in) = (2, 3) and the bias as (2,); the gradient of a scalar loss has the same shape as the parameter, so dL/dW is (2, 3) and dL/db is (2,).

  • 3.2 学习率实验：0.001 太小（300 步后损失仍最高，≈ 0.16114）；0.01 合适（≈ 0.15962，接近闭式解 0.15910）；0.03 发散（第 102 步变成 inf）。原因：MSE 对 (b, w) 是二次碗，梯度下降只有在 η < 2/λ_max（λ_max 是 Hessian 最大特征值）时稳定，和 L3 的 ½θ² 例子同一个道理；这个数据集的 Hessian 是 (2/n)X̃ᵀX̃，算出来 2/λ_max ≈ 0.024：0.01 在阈值以下，0.03 超过了它。

    3.2 learning-rate experiment: 0.001 is too small (highest loss after 300 steps, ≈ 0.16114); 0.01 is right (≈ 0.15962, close to the closed-form 0.15910); 0.03 diverges (inf at step 102). Reason: MSE is a quadratic bowl in (b, w), and gradient descent is stable only when η < 2/λ_max (largest Hessian eigenvalue) — the same idea as L3's ½θ² example; for this dataset the Hessian is (2/n)X̃ᵀX̃ and 2/λ_max ≈ 0.024: 0.01 is below it, 0.03 above.

  • 3.3 闭式解：增广矩阵 X̃ 每行 (1, xᵢ)，β = (b, w)ᵀ。令梯度为 0 得正规方程 X̃ᵀX̃β = X̃ᵀy，可逆时 β* = (X̃ᵀX̃)⁻¹X̃ᵀy；奇异时（特征线性相关）解不唯一，用 Moore–Penrose 伪逆 β* = X̃⁺y（最小范数解，实践中用 lstsq）。你的结果：w = 0.26864，b = 0.71504，MSE = 0.15910；与 SGD 差 |Δw| ≈ 0.0092、|Δb| ≈ 0.063。不为 0 的原因：SGD 只迭代了有限步、只是渐近接近最优点；而且 PyTorch 默认 float32，闭式解用 float64。

    3.3 closed form: rows of X̃ are (1, xᵢ), β = (b, w)ᵀ. Setting the gradient to zero gives X̃ᵀX̃β = X̃ᵀy, so β* = (X̃ᵀX̃)⁻¹X̃ᵀy when invertible; when singular use the pseudoinverse β* = X̃⁺y (minimum-norm solution, lstsq in practice). Your result: w = 0.26864, b = 0.71504, MSE = 0.15910; differences from SGD |Δw| ≈ 0.0092, |Δb| ≈ 0.063, because SGD ran finitely many steps and only approaches the optimum, and PyTorch uses float32 while the closed form used float64.

Jridge=1n∥X~β−y∥2+λ β⊤R β,R=diag(0,1) ⟹ β⋆=(X~⊤X~+nλR)−1X~⊤yJ_{\mathrm{ridge}} = \tfrac1n\lVert \tilde X\beta - y\rVert^2 + \lambda\,\beta^\top R\,\beta,\quad R=\mathrm{diag}(0,1)\ \Longrightarrow\ \beta^\star = \bigl(\tilde X^\top\tilde X + n\lambda R\bigr)^{-1}\tilde X^\top yJridge​=n1​∥X~β−y∥2+λβ⊤Rβ,R=diag(0,1) ⟹ β⋆=(X~⊤X~+nλR)−1X~⊤y

  • 4.1 Ridge：R = diag(0, 1) 表示只惩罚 w、不惩罚 b；注意题目损失是「平均」平方误差，所以闭式解里是 nλR（损失写成求和就是 λR）。λ = 0, 0.1, 1, 10 时 w = 0.2686, 0.2637, 0.2262, 0.0934，训练 MSE = 0.1591, 0.1592, 0.1687, 0.3228。λ 变大，w 单调缩向 0（收缩）；b 不受罚，往 ȳ 移动来补偿；不加正则的训练 MSE 只会变大（λ = 0 已经是 MSE 的最优点）——偏差换方差。

    4.1 Ridge: R = diag(0, 1) penalises w but not b; because the loss is a mean squared error the closed form has nλR (λR if the loss were a sum). For λ = 0, 0.1, 1, 10: w = 0.2686, 0.2637, 0.2262, 0.0934, training MSE 0.1591, 0.1592, 0.1687, 0.3228. As λ grows w shrinks monotonically towards 0, the unpenalised b moves towards ȳ to compensate, and the unregularised training MSE can only rise (λ = 0 is already its minimiser) — bias traded for variance.

  • 4.2 Lasso：J = MSE + λ∣w∣，∣w∣ 在 0 处不可导，没有正规方程那样的闭式解，所以用 Adam 迭代求。λ = 0, 0.05, 0.2, 0.8 时 w = 0.2686, 0.2640, 0.2499, 0.1936。L1 的「推力」是常数 λ·sign(w)，λ 足够大时能把系数正好压到 0（稀疏）；L2 的推力 2λw 越靠近 0 越小，只会缩小、几乎不会恰好为 0。比较模型要看不加正则项的 MSE，带正则的目标值不能直接比。

    4.2 Lasso: J = MSE + λ∣w∣; ∣w∣ is not differentiable at 0 and there is no normal-equation closed form, so Adam is used. For λ = 0, 0.05, 0.2, 0.8: w = 0.2686, 0.2640, 0.2499, 0.1936. The L1 push is a constant λ·sign(w), so a large enough λ drives a coefficient exactly to 0 (sparsity); the L2 push 2λw fades near 0, so it shrinks but almost never hits 0. Compare models with the unregularised MSE, not the regularised objective.

2. 作业 3：用 NumPy 手写单隐层 MLPAssignment 3: a one-hidden-layer MLP in NumPy

考什么：数据划分（64/16/20）、只在训练集上拟合标准化、相关系数筛特征的局限、前向和反向传播的矩阵形状、He 初始化、mini-batch SGD、RMSE 与 R²、隐藏层宽度和过拟合。

Tested: the 64/16/20 split, fitting the standardiser on the training set only, limits of correlation screening, matrix shapes in forward and backward passes, He initialisation, mini-batch SGD, RMSE and R², hidden width and overfitting.

  • 2.1 为什么标准化统计量只能用训练集：① 验证集、测试集代表「没见过的数据」，用它们的均值方差就把它们的信息泄露进了训练，评估会偏乐观；② 每个划分各自标准化更糟：同一个原始输入在不同划分里被映射成不同的数，模型测的是另一个分布；③ 部署时只有训练统计量，新样本一条条到来，没法算它们的均值方差。零或极小的标准差要换成 1，避免除以 0。

    2.1 why only training statistics: (1) validation and test sets stand in for unseen data, and using their statistics leaks that information into training, biasing evaluation upwards; (2) standardising each split separately is worse — the same raw input maps to different numbers in different splits; (3) at deployment only training statistics exist. Replace a zero or tiny standard deviation by 1.

  • 2.2 相关系数小不代表没用：Pearson 只衡量线性、**单变量（边缘）**关系。U 形关系正负斜率抵消，相关接近 0；交互作用（如 sex 改变 BMI 的效应）单看一个特征看不到；相关特征之间会互相掩盖。你的数据里 sex 相关 −0.017、s2 相关 0.123 最小；去掉它们后验证 RMSE 从 55.76 变成 56.26，测试 R² 从 0.4716 降到 0.4595，反而变差。

    2.2 a small correlation does not mean useless: Pearson measures only linear, marginal association. U-shaped effects cancel out, interactions (sex modifying the effect of BMI) are invisible to a single feature, and correlated features can mask each other. In your data sex (−0.017) and s2 (0.123) were weakest; removing them made validation RMSE worse (55.76 → 56.26) and test R² worse (0.4716 → 0.4595).

Z1=XW1+b1,H1=ReLU(Z1),Y^=H1W2+b2,L=1B∥Y^−Y∥2Z_1 = XW_1 + b_1,\quad H_1=\mathrm{ReLU}(Z_1),\quad \hat Y = H_1W_2+b_2,\quad L=\tfrac1B\lVert \hat Y - Y\rVert^2Z1​=XW1​+b1​,H1​=ReLU(Z1​),Y^=H1​W2​+b2​,L=B1​∥Y^−Y∥2
δ2=2B(Y^−Y),  ∂L∂W2=H1⊤δ2,  ∂L∂b2=∑rowsδ2,  δ1=(δ2W2⊤)⊙1[Z1>0],  ∂L∂W1=X⊤δ1,  ∂L∂b1=∑rowsδ1\delta_2=\tfrac{2}{B}(\hat Y-Y),\ \ \tfrac{\partial L}{\partial W_2}=H_1^\top\delta_2,\ \ \tfrac{\partial L}{\partial b_2}=\textstyle\sum_{\text{rows}}\delta_2,\ \ \delta_1=(\delta_2W_2^\top)\odot\mathbb 1[Z_1>0],\ \ \tfrac{\partial L}{\partial W_1}=X^\top\delta_1,\ \ \tfrac{\partial L}{\partial b_1}=\textstyle\sum_{\text{rows}}\delta_1δ2​=B2​(Y^−Y),  ∂W2​∂L​=H1⊤​δ2​,  ∂b2​∂L​=∑rows​δ2​,  δ1​=(δ2​W2⊤​)⊙1[Z1​>0],  ∂W1​∂L​=X⊤δ1​,  ∂b1​∂L​=∑rows​δ1​

  • 形状检查（闭卷手写反向传播最好用的自检）：X 是 B × d，W₁ 是 d × h，W₂ 是 h × 1。∂L/∂W₁ 必须是 d × h，只有 Xᵀ(B × d → d × B) 乘 δ₁(B × h) 能得到；偏置梯度是对 batch 求和。ReLU 的导数在 Z₁ ≤ 0 处是 0，所以 δ₁ 在那些位置被清零。He 初始化：W₁ 的标准差 √(2/d)，偏置初始化为 0。

    Shape check (the best self-test when writing backprop by hand): X is B × d, W₁ d × h, W₂ h × 1. ∂L/∂W₁ must be d × h, which only Xᵀ (d × B) times δ₁ (B × h) gives; bias gradients sum over the batch. ReLU's derivative is 0 where Z₁ ≤ 0, so δ₁ is zeroed there. He initialisation: std √(2/d) for W₁, zero biases.

  • 4.1 指标：RMSE = √(平均平方误差)，和目标同单位；R² = 1 − SSE/SST，表示比「永远预测均值」好多少（R² = 0 就是只会预测均值，可以为负）。注意要先把标准化后的预测变换回原始尺度再算。你的结果：测试 RMSE 52.91，R² 0.4716。

    4.1 metrics: RMSE = √(mean squared error), in target units; R² = 1 − SSE/SST, how much better than always predicting the mean (R² = 0 means predicting the mean; it can be negative). Transform standardised predictions back to the original scale first. Your result: test RMSE 52.91, R² 0.4716.

  • 4.3 宽度：宽 4、16、64 的最佳验证 RMSE 是 56.81、55.48、57.98，U 形。宽 4 欠拟合（偏差大）；宽 64 有 64 × 10 + 64 + 64 + 1 = 769 个参数却只有 282 个训练样本，拟合到噪声（方差大）。加宽只增加表示能力，不保证泛化；比较宽度要用验证集，测试集留到最后。

    4.3 width: best validation RMSE 56.81, 55.48, 57.98 for widths 4, 16, 64 — U-shaped. Width 4 underfits (bias); width 64 has 769 parameters for 282 samples and fits noise (variance). Width buys capacity, not generalisation; compare widths on validation, keep the test set for the end.

3. 作业 4：自己实现 AdamAssignment 4: implementing Adam

mt=β1mt−1+(1−β1)gt,vt=β2vt−1+(1−β2)gt2,m^t=mt1−β1t,v^t=vt1−β2t,θt=θt−1−αm^tv^t+ϵm_t=\beta_1m_{t-1}+(1-\beta_1)g_t,\quad v_t=\beta_2v_{t-1}+(1-\beta_2)g_t^2,\quad \hat m_t=\frac{m_t}{1-\beta_1^t},\quad \hat v_t=\frac{v_t}{1-\beta_2^t},\quad \theta_t=\theta_{t-1}-\alpha\frac{\hat m_t}{\sqrt{\hat v_t}+\epsilon}mt​=β1​mt−1​+(1−β1​)gt​,vt​=β2​vt−1​+(1−β2​)gt2​,m^t​=1−β1t​mt​​,v^t​=1−β2t​vt​​,θt​=θt−1​−αv^t​​+ϵm^t​​

  • 两个矩的作用：mₜ 是梯度的指数滑动平均（动量），平均掉 mini-batch 噪声、保持方向；vₜ 是梯度平方的滑动平均，估计每个坐标梯度的典型大小，除以 √v̂ₜ 让每个参数有自己的步长（自适应）；ε 只防止除以 0。

    Roles of the moments: mₜ is an exponential moving average of gradients (momentum), smoothing mini-batch noise; vₜ averages squared gradients and estimates each coordinate's typical gradient size, so dividing by √v̂ₜ gives each parameter its own step size; ε only prevents division by zero.

  • 为什么要偏差修正：m₀ = v₀ = 0，所以 E[mₜ] = (1 − β₁ᵗ)E[g]、E[vₜ] = (1 − β₂ᵗ)E[g²]，早期都偏向 0。两个偏差不会在 m/√v 里抵消：第一步不修正时 m₁/√v₁ = (1 − β₁)g/(√(1 − β₂)∣g∣) = 0.1/0.0316 ≈ 3.16，步长约 3.16α；修正后正好是 α·sign(g)。t 大时 1 − βᵗ → 1，修正自动消失。

    Why bias correction: m₀ = v₀ = 0, so E[mₜ] = (1 − β₁ᵗ)E[g] and E[vₜ] = (1 − β₂ᵗ)E[g²], both biased towards 0 early on. The biases do not cancel in m/√v: without correction the first step is 0.1/0.0316 ≈ 3.16 times α; with it the first step is exactly α·sign(g). For large t the correction switches itself off.

  • 每个参数各自的 t：某参数这一步 grad is None（比如没参与计算）就跳过，它的 m、v 和步数 t 都不变；偏差修正用它自己的 t，而不是 step() 被调用的总次数。这和 torch.optim.Adam 一致；验证测试里 b 在第 2 步没有梯度，之后 b 的 t 比 a 少 1。你的实现与官方差最大 5.55 × 10⁻¹⁷（float64 舍入误差），PASS。

    Per-parameter t: a parameter whose grad is None this step is skipped — its m, v and t are unchanged — and bias correction uses its own t, not the number of step() calls, matching torch.optim.Adam. In the test, b had no gradient at step 2, so afterwards b's t is one less than a's. Your implementation matched to 5.55 × 10⁻¹⁷ (float64 rounding): PASS.

  • 为什么数值对比比「损失下降」更可靠：一个漏了偏差修正、或把 β₁、β₂ 写反的优化器仍然大致往下走、损失照样下降；只有逐步对比参数才能发现这种错误。

    Why a numerical comparison beats "the loss went down": an optimiser missing bias correction or with β₁ and β₂ swapped still moves roughly downhill and still lowers the loss; only a step-by-step parameter comparison catches it.

4. 作业 5：从零训练 Qwen3-0.6BAssignment 5: training Qwen3-0.6B from scratch

  • 配置：随机初始化（只下载结构配置和分词器，不下载权重），596M 参数；C4 流式读取，每条截断到 128 token；Adam(0.9, 0.999)、权重衰减 0.01、梯度裁剪 1.0、bf16；你选的学习率 5 × 10⁻⁴、300 步、梯度累积 8（每卡 batch 1 ⇒ 有效 batch = 1 × 8 = 8 条序列）；warm-up 30 步后余弦衰减。

    Setup: random initialisation (only config and tokenizer downloaded), 596M parameters; C4 streamed and truncated to 128 tokens; Adam(0.9, 0.999), weight decay 0.01, clipping 1.0, bf16; your choices lr 5 × 10⁻⁴, 300 steps, gradient accumulation 8 (per-device batch 1 ⇒ effective batch 8 sequences); 30 warm-up steps then cosine decay.

  • 初始损失为什么约 12：随机初始化的模型对每个词几乎均匀，交叉熵 ≈ ln V；词表约 15 万，ln 151,669 ≈ 11.9，你观察到的前 5 步平均 12.10 正好对上（L9 的「初始损失 ≈ ln V」）。300 步后降到约 8.20。

    Why the initial loss is about 12: a randomly initialised model is nearly uniform over the vocabulary, so cross-entropy ≈ ln V; with V ≈ 151,669, ln V ≈ 11.9, matching your first-five-step average of 12.10 (L9's "initial loss ≈ ln V"). After 300 steps it was about 8.20.

  • 曲线形状：前约 40 步（warm-up 和峰值学习率）下降最快，到约 8.7；之后在 7.8–8.7 之间噪声很大的平台缓慢下降，随余弦衰减变平。噪声大（约 ±0.4）是因为每次更新只用 8 × 128 ≈ 1,000 个 token。为什么 warm-up：Adam 早期的矩估计不稳、随机初始化时梯度大，先用小学习率。梯度累积：显存放不下大 batch 时，连续做 8 次前向/反向、梯度累加后再更新一次，效果等价于 batch 8。

    Curve: the steepest drop is in the first ~40 steps (warm-up and peak lr), to about 8.7; then a noisy plateau between 7.8 and 8.7 declining slowly as the cosine schedule lowers the lr. The noise (about ±0.4) comes from only 8 × 128 ≈ 1,000 tokens per update. Warm-up: Adam's early moment estimates are unstable and gradients are large at random init. Gradient accumulation: when a big batch does not fit, run 8 forward/backward passes, sum gradients, update once — equivalent to batch 8.

作业 2–5 易错点Assignments 2–5 common mistakes

  • Ridge 闭式解里的 λ 要和损失的写法对应：平均损失对应 nλR，求和损失对应 λR；偏置不罚，所以 R 的 (1, 1) 元素是 0。

    λ in the Ridge closed form must match how the loss is written: nλR for a mean, λR for a sum; the bias is unpenalised, so R₁₁ = 0.

  • 比较不同 λ 的模型要用不带正则项的 MSE。

    Compare models across λ with the unregularised MSE.

  • 反向传播里偏置的梯度是对 batch 求和（或按损失定义求平均），形状和偏置相同；ReLU 在 z ≤ 0 处梯度为 0。

    Bias gradients sum over the batch (or average, following the loss), with the bias's shape; ReLU's gradient is 0 where z ≤ 0.

  • 有效 batch = 每卡 batch × 卡数 × 梯度累积步数。

    Effective batch = per-device batch × number of devices × accumulation steps.
